strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.description:
Overview
 
  As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.
 
 


 
  

   ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.
 
 


 
  

   Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.
 
 
 
  

   Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.
 
 


 
  

   PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments.
 
 

    Responsibilities


 
  ERP analyst relationships
 
 
  Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
  Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
  Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
  Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.
  Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.
 
 


 
  

   Digital marketing agency relationships
 
 
  Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.
  Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
  Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
  Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
  Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.
 
 


 
  

   Portfolio management & reporting
 
 
  Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
  Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
  Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
  Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go-to-market teams.
 
 


 
  

   Cross-functional collaboration
 
 
  Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
  Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.
  Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations.
 
 

    Qualifications


 
  Required
 
 
  10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.
  Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.
  Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
  Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.
  Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.
  Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms.
 
 


 
  

   Preferred
 
 
  Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators — you have existing relationships in this community.
  Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.
  Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
 
 

   Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

 The expected base pay range for this position is: 
 

  Albany $189,500 - $256,000 
 

  California Remote (Bay Area) $186,500- $252,500 
 

  California Remote (Not Bay Area) $179,000- $242,500

marketingbusinessdevelopmentcoordinatoru.title: Marketing & Business Development Coordinator
marketingbusinessdevelopmentcoordinatoru.description:
Unió Digital has grown almost entirely on word of mouth. This role is how we widen that. The Marketing & Business Development Coordinator owns top-of-funnel engagement: the vendor-funded programs, the hosted events, the social presence, and the content that puts us in front of Arizona businesses before they have a problem to solve.

This is a new role, both for Unió Digital and for the Sales & Marketing team. We are a small company in a growth phase, so expect to wear several hats and expect the shape of the job to move as we learn what works. Whoever takes this seat helps define what it becomes rather than inheriting a finished playbook.

In a given month you might build a co-marketing campaign against a vendor's marketing development fund budget, host a lunch-and-learn for a dozen operations managers, run a webinar with one of our security partners, publish a blog post and tune the page it lives on, and keep LinkedIn moving in between. You will be out of the office and in front of people regularly, including some evenings.

We do not hard sell. Clients call us back because we find the thing that is actually broken and fix it. Every conversation you start should follow that pattern: understand the problem first, then talk about whether we are the right answer.

Responsibilities:

Generate awareness and inbound conversations beyond referrals, and grow the top of the funnel in the Tucson and southern Arizona marketOwn vendor marketing development fund (MDF) programs: propose co-marketing plans, submit for approval, execute them, and report results back to the vendorHost and run events end to end, from invite list through follow-up: lunch-and-learns, client dinners, vendor showcases, and webinarsRun the social channels with a consistent voice and a real cadence (LinkedIn first, then Instagram and Facebook)Write and publish blog content, and make the minor website and on-page SEO updates that keep it findableRepresent Unió Digital at chambers, associations, trade shows, and community eventsOpen consultative conversations with prospects and referral sources, then hand qualified opportunities to the account teamTrack what works: event attendance, content performance, channel growth, and the conversations each one producesQualifications:

2+ years in B2B marketing, events, partner marketing, or a comparable outward-facing role; vendor or channel marketing exposure (MDF, co-op funds, partner programs) is a plus, not a requirementComfortable hosting a room: able to run a lunch-and-learn or a webinar without a script and keep it usefulWorking knowledge of SEO and web content, enough to publish a post and fix the page it sits on (WordPress, HubSpot, or comparable)Strong written voice; able to draft copy and turn a technician's explanation into something a business owner will actually readA consultative instinct: you ask what is broken before you talk about what we sellComfortable building something that does not exist yet: this is a new seat, and the priorities will move as we find out what worksEligible to work in the U.S.; based in or relocating to Tucson, AZ; available for occasional evening and early-morning events

The Senior Communications Specialist role requires a self-starter, proactive problem solver and action-oriented team player with previous experience in management consulting and business development pursuits. This position needs an individual that is committed to providing superior service, poised under pressure and has a positive and flexible attitude.

This is a contingent hire position. Offers will be contingent upon client approval, ability to meet security requirements, and the ability to adhere to any on-site requirements (which may change at contract award).

Remote work is anticipated. However, occasional travel for client engagements may be required.

partnershipsocialmediaspecialistvisitmes.title: Partnership & Social Media Specialist
partnershipsocialmediaspecialistvisitmes.description:
Position Summary: The Partnership & Social Media Specialist supports Visit Mesa’s Partnership Program and consumer marketing efforts by coordinating partner engagement, fulfilling partnership benefits, and creating and supporting social media content. This partner-facing role helps ensure a consistent, high-quality partner experience through timely communication, organized execution of contracted deliverables, and in-market content capture. 
 

   Working closely with the Director, Destination Experience and Content Marketing Manager, the Specialist serves as a key connector between Visit Mesa partners and internal teams while contributing to Visit Mesa’s content pipeline and destination storytelling.


  ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


  Partnership Engagement & Supports


 
  
   Conduct regular in-market visits with partners based on partnership team priorities.
   Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned partner questions, requests, and follow-up, escalating strategic, sensitive, or revenue-related matters to the Director, Destination Experience as appropriate.
   Share relevant Visit Mesa updates, gather partner feedback, and identify opportunities, needs, and potential concerns.
   Manage assigned partner renewals, including outreach, follow-up, presentation of partnership performance, and identification of appropriate upsell opportunities that increase partner value and revenue.
   Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, requests, and follow-up items in the CRM.
   Support partner onboarding, orientations, and training, conducted in person or virtually, by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, and following up on next steps.
   Help strengthen partner satisfaction and retention through consistent communication and responsive support.
  
 
  Partnership Deliverables & Fulfillment


 
  
   Coordinate and track contracted partnership benefits and deliverables to help ensure accurate, timely fulfillment.
   Maintain deliverable timelines, status updates, and supporting documentation.
   Coordinate with internal teams, including marketing, sales, creative, and communications, to facilitate partner benefits and confirm expectations.
   Serve as a liaison between assigned partners and internal teams regarding deliverable details, deadlines, and required materials.
   Assist with preparing partner updates and supporting materials that communicate the value and results of Visit Mesa partnership benefits.
   Identify potential fulfillment gaps or delays and communicate them promptly to the Director, Destination Experience.
  
 
  Content Capture & Social Media Support


 
  
   Capture photo and video content during partner visits, events, and destination experiences for use across Visit Mesa marketing channels.
   Assist with the development of partner-focused content that highlights Mesa businesses, experiences, events, and destination offerings.
   Support social media execution by drafting and scheduling posts, monitoring comments and messages, and engaging with audiences in alignment with Visit Mesa’s voice and established guidelines.
   Coordinate with the Content Marketing Manager to ensure partner-related content aligns with the content calendar, campaign priorities, and brand standards.
   Organize and maintain content assets, permissions, and relevant partner information for efficient future use.
   Stay current on social media trends, emerging platforms, and community engagement opportunities, sharing relevant ideas with the marketing team.
  
 
  Community Outreach & Cross-Functional Support


 
  
   Represent Visit Mesa professionally at partner meetings, partnership events, community events, and relevant industry functions.
   Support partnership events, outreach activities, and initiatives that promote partner engagement and revenue growth.
   Assist with special projects and other department needs as assigned.
   Help maintain the visitor center and answer incoming phone calls as needed.
  
 
  Qualifications


 
  
   Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Tourism, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
   Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in content marketing, digital communications, or a related field.
   Hospitality, tourism, association, or economic development experience preferred.
   Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills with the ability to adapt content for diverse audiences.
   Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment.
   Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and PowerPoint) required; experience with Adobe Creative Suite and email marketing platforms preferred.
   Ability to quickly learn industry-specific platforms and emerging marketing technologies.
  
 
  Core Competencies


 
  
   Content strategy, storytelling, and exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to create engaging, audience-focused content while maintaining Visit Mesa's brand voice and standards.
   Project and campaign management, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
   Data-informed decision-making using performance metrics, audience insights, and analytics to optimize content and campaigns.
   Collaboration and relationship building across departments, agency partners, vendors, and community stakeholders.
   Creativity, innovation, and adaptability with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current on emerging marketing trends and technologies.
   Ability to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance content development, audience engagement, marketing effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
   Commitment to Visit Mesa's mission, values, and destination marketing objectives.
  
 
  Position Details


 
  
   Full-time, non-exempt position
   Hybrid (office located in Downtown Mesa)
   Full health benefits and 401(k) opportunity
   Salary: $60,000 - $65,000 (DOE)
   Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, with minimal evening and weekend hours required
  
 
  Expectations


 The Partnership & Social Media Specialist is expected to adhere to all Visit Mesa rules of employment as described in the employee manual. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned and not included in this job description to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.


 


 

   All questions about this job description should be directed to Audry Brinkman, Director, People and Operations, at audry@visitmesa.com, or at 480-682-3789.

Overview



Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.



The American Heart Association has an exciting opportunity for a  Marketing Communications Director  serving the Nevada and Southern Arizona Division teams.



This hybrid role may be based in Las Vegas, NV, or Tucson, AZ, with work taking place across home office, community, and office settings to support marketing, communications, and mission-driven initiatives.



The Marketing Communications Director develops and implements strategic communications, marketing, media relations, and public relations initiatives for the American Heart Association across the Nevada and Southern, while providing communications support for other territories as needed. This role advances the American Heart Association’s position as the leading authority on cardiovascular health and science through integrated external and internal communications, marketing campaigns, media outreach, digital strategies, sponsorship activation, and special initiatives.



The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.



#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.



Responsibilities



Brand   Integrity

Support day-to-day marketing execution across Logitech G's portfolio of global partnerships, including game publishers, technology partners, and brands. Manage campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, asset coordination, and cross-functional workflows with Global Brand, Product Marketing, Regional Marketing, Creative, PR, and Digital teams. Proven experience in Partner Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Brand Marketing, Gaming Marketing, or a related field.

Discretion and Professionalism: Skilled at handling sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and diplomacy; you effectively deal with ambiguity, building trust and credibility.

Excel: Must be able to use excel for data analysis and reporting. Must have used or knowledgeable about project management tools.

Bachelor\'s Degree required and a minimum of three - five years of relevant experience in event planning or PR roles.

## Job Description

Posting Date 10/12/2026 225 E Germann RdSte 150, Gilbert, Arizona, 85297-2909, United States of America

We are seeking a mission-driven Partner Marketing Administrator to build awareness of health plans that offer the support of DaVita's value-based care program through direct, local engagement with kidney care patients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on face-to-face interaction, understands the value of personalized healthcare, and the impact of patient choice in health coverage. You will spend time in dialysis clinics, engage with eligible patients and caregivers, and build trust that leads to informed health insurance decisions. You'll also work closely with care teams and local leadership to understand how the care management program works alongside strong health plan benefits to support this patient community.

Note: You must possess or be willing to obtain the required licensure to educate on health plans in the state of Arizona, called the Life and Health Insurance License. If you are selected for the role but do not possess the required licensure, DaVita will reimburse the cost of obtaining the licensure.

### Position Details

- Must reside in Phoenix, AZ

- Commute to Davita Clinics in surrounding areas

- Required to be in Davita clinics 5 days per week between 7:30 and 2:30

- Travel to Denver HQ 1-2 times annually

- Mileage for daily commute reimbursed

### Key Responsibilities

Represent the value-based care program's affiliated health plans within dialysis clinics and the surrounding community to raise awareness, build trust, and support informed patient coverage decisions.

Build strong relationships with in-clinic staff—facility administrators, social workers, and administrative assistants—to facilitate coordinated, compliant marketing efforts.

Develop a strong understanding of the plan's benefits, eligibility criteria, and the role of care management in driving better health outcomes for members.

Partner with assigned brokers to support enrollment of interested patients.

Communicate plan and program information in a clear, ethical, and compliant manner—ensuring CMS marketing guidelines and internal compliance guardrails are followed.

Identify barriers to engagement and provide insights that improve our local marketing approach.

Track engagement and field activity metrics to support performance evaluation and continuous improvement.

Potential to represent the plan at community events or engage existing members for retention activities.

Travel to clinic locations at least four days per week to speak with kidney care patients, caregivers, and clinic staff.

Occasional option to work Saturdays and evening events, if desired.

### Qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent required.

- Active Arizona Life and Health Insurance License required

- Medicare Advantage marketing experience strongly preferred.

- 2–4 years of experience in healthcare marketing, insurance sales, grassroots outreach, or community engagement preferred.

- Proven relationship-builder with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Comfortable working independently in a field-based role, with strong personal organization.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, SharePoint).

- Must reside near the Maricopa County area and possess a valid Arizona driver's license and reliable transportation—a majority of time will be spent inside dialysis clinics or traveling locally. (This role will drive their personal automobile to get from one clinic to another; DaVita will reimburse mileage costs).

- Bilingual / Spanish-speaking is strongly preferred.

### What We're Looking For

Passion for connecting kidney care populations with healthcare options tailored to their needs. Confidence to communicate clearly, compassionately, and compliantly about health plans and our care program. Curiosity to learn and explain how care management complements plan benefits. Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, evolving pilot environment. Drive to help build and scale a locally rooted, high-impact marketing model.

### What We'll Provide

More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.

- Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out

- Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more

- Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita's online training platform StarLearning.

The Global Brand & Communications PMO team keeps the whole Brand, Communications, Marketing, and CSR organization running, including systems, budgets, planning cycles, cross-functional projects, and the tentpole moments that no single team can run alone.

We translate fast-moving global agendas into clear workflows, well-run campaigns, and decisions leaders can actually make. You will work directly with leaders across Communications, Marketing, CSR, Finance, Legal, HR, and Product, and get a front-row seat to how a global brand really operates, not just how it presents itself.

The Global Brand & Comms Operations team creates the operational foundation that enables Global Brand & Comms to do its best work. As strategic partners, the team builds the systems, standards, and ways of working that drive clarity, consistency, speed, and operational excellence across the organization. Working across Global Communications, Global CSR, and Global Marketing, we connect teams, align cross-functional partners, and ensure work moves forward efficiently and strategically around the world. The team also serves as a liaison to key XFN partners, including Procurement, Finance, Legal and Human Resources.  Though individually based in AMS, APAC, and EMEA, we operate as one global PMO team with shared ways of working.

PMOs work to seamlessly integrate strategy and operations to drive consistency across the Global Brand & Comms department. You help connect dots and strengthen information sharing, so teams are able to drive stronger results for the business. This includes department-level operations as well as projects that span Global Comms, Global CSR, and Global Marketing. All PMOs on the Operations team have both global and regional accountability.  The role is rooted in cross-functional project management, problem-solving and planning, and organization and management of key initiatives. PMOs play a strong role in supporting both the operational functions of the department and teams within it, while also helping to manage external campaigns. It's important to think quickly and adapt to change in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities
- Lead project management of key projects and facilitate seamless communication between project teams, executives and cross-functional partners, while building strong relationships throughout the company
- Proactively identify areas for process improvement across the Brand and Communications teams and implement solutions
- Coordinate, manage, and support special projects for department leaders, ensuring timely and efficient execution
- Support strategic initiatives with relevant Global Brand & Communications partners to aid in decision making
- Streamline processes and workflows to drive efficiencies to enable teams to operate at scale 
- Organize and manage team and department-wide meetings as needed
- Provide project support for teams as needed across Finance, Procurement, Legal
- Collaborate with the broader PMO team on a variety of projects and campaigns including but not limited to: improving and maintaining department resources and documents, onboarding of new team members and agencies, knowledge sharing across the department and more.

- Experience handling confidential information with discretion and maintaining a high level of professionalism required
- Demonstrated working experience in Communications, Marketing, project management and/or an operations-focused role
- Exceptional project management and operations skills, with the ability to meet deadlines and drive strong execution in a fast-paced environment
- Strong presentation skills, particularly implemented in a cross-functional and global role
- Exceptional listening, problem-solving, verbal and written communication skills
- Respect for and desire to learn from other cultures
- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing or related fields

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Extraordinary organizational skills with the ability to work cross-functionally with other stakeholder teams as well as executive leadership
- Experience working in a global capacity and with global companies
- Experience with project management and/or database tools

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

On the Waymo Marketing team, you will help to connect people with the magic and impact of Waymo's autonomous driving technology. Our team has the unique opportunity to not only grow Waymo's brand from the ground up, but to also build societal acceptance for autonomous driving technology for the first time in history. We build thoughtful marketing strategy, positioning, messaging and creative assets to deliver messages that matter to our audience, communicated through anything from video content, to social media interactions, to immersive physical experiences. We also shape Waymo's go-to-market initiatives, helping to transform Waymo into a thriving business with a growing user base.


In this hybrid role based in Los Angeles or New York, you will report to the Global Experiential Marketing Lead.    


You Will: 



Spearhead US and select global experiential marketing strategies, driving high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.
Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of sponsorships and partnerships, leading property identification, strategic alignment, commercial negotiations, and on-site brand experiences.
Drive end-to-end event-based strategy defining target audience segments, determining optimal event formats and scale, and establishing clear measurement frameworks to drive business impact.
Serve as the steward of Waymo’s brand vision, translating brand strategy into immersive, world-class experiences that foster public trust in autonomous technology.
Lead event sponsorship deal structuring and contract negotiations partnering with cross-functional partners, legal and finance teams to maximize asset value, ensure favorable commercial terms, and protect brand interests across all agreements.
Mobilize leadership and cross-functional teams behind event priorities, securing rapid approvals through clear, proactive communication to execute at speed.
Manage program budgets with attention to detail, optimizing resource allocation and vendor negotiations to deliver premium activations with high cost-efficiency.

You Have: 



10+ years in an event specific role leading high-impact experiences in the US.
Deep knowledge of the region’s experiential landscape, with a strong understanding of regional event industry trends and audiences.
Extensive experience navigating the event sponsorship ecosystem, with a proven ability to evaluate value, negotiate high-stakes agreements, and oversee seamless on-site asset delivery.
Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality with the flexibility to jump into operational, creative, or logistical functions to keep projects moving forward as we scale the team.
A natural ability to balance high-level strategy with hands-on tactical execution, seamlessly pivoting across shifting priorities and expanding project scopes.

We Prefer: 



Global sponsorship experience. 
Experience in the autonomous vehicle, mobility, or a similarly highly regulated, pioneering technology sector.
Experience thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

30% - Willing to travel globally as required

The Bank Product Marketing team shapes and implements product-specific marketing strategies to efficiently and effectively drive growth. The team is responsible for driving prioritization to ensure alignment with business objectives and market opportunities.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Job Posting

JR102239 Digital Communications Specialist (Contingent II -- Grant Funded) (Open)

Department

Job Description

Under general supervision, performs a variety of routine professional and analytical assignments involving the practical application of management principles and techniques to routine operational activities.

The Digital Communications and Project Support Specialist supports the Department of Information Technology’s Business Operations unit through digital content development, technology communications, project documentation, and administrative support for assigned initiatives. The position prepares clear, accessible communications and maintains organized materials that support Title III Digital Transformation activities and other approved departmental projects. Working under the direction of the Director of Business Operations and in collaboration with the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator, the Specialist completes assigned communication, documentation, tracking, and logistical tasks.

Duties & Responsibilities

Digital Communications and Content Development

 Draft and update technology announcements, newsletters, website content, FAQs, service notices, and other approved communications. Translate information provided by technical and project leads into clear language for faculty, staff, students, and other stakeholders. Maintain a communications calendar for assigned projects, announcements, and departmental initiatives. Review content for accuracy, readability, accessibility, and consistency with university standards before submission for approval.

Project Documentation and Coordination Support

 Support the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator by preparing meeting materials, documenting assigned meetings, and recording decisions and action items. Maintain assigned project trackers, contact lists, documentation checklists, and shared folders using information provided by project owners. Request routine updates and missing materials as assigned and notify the Coordinator of overdue responses or incomplete documentation. Format project summaries, status reports, presentations, and closeout materials using approved content.

Title III Activity and Evidence Support

 Collect and organize supporting documentation for assigned Title III activities, including approved progress updates, communications, event materials, and evidence of completed deliverables. Maintain evidence folders and documentation checklists to support progress reporting and evaluation preparation. Prepare visual summaries and presentation materials that communicate project accomplishments and benefits. Refer questions about grant requirements, expenditures, or reporting decisions to the Activity Director or Project Coordinator.

Technology Awareness and Change Communications

 Prepare approved communications regarding technology changes, service improvements, implementation milestones, and scheduled disruptions. Develop awareness content promoting available technology services, cybersecurity practices, and university technology initiatives. Coordinate publication and distribution of approved messages through designated university channels.

Event and Stakeholder Support

 Assist with communications, registration, materials, scheduling details, and participant reminders for assigned technology events and stakeholder meetings. Compile attendance information and feedback summaries for review by the Project Coordinator. Maintain reusable communication templates and event materials.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 Knowledge of digital communications, content development, and basic technical writing practices. Ability to translate technical information into clear, concise language for faculty, staff, students, and other audiences. Ability to draft, edit, proofread, and format announcements, newsletters, website content, FAQs, reports, and presentations. Knowledge of basic accessibility practices for digital content and documents. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage assigned tasks, competing deadlines, and routine follow-up. Ability to maintain accurate trackers, meeting notes, action items, documentation checklists, and shared electronic records. Ability to gather and organize information and supporting evidence for project updates, grant reporting, and evaluations. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, or comparable tools. Ability to use digital publishing, design, and collaboration tools to prepare professional communications and supporting materials. Ability to support meeting and event logistics, participant communications, and feedback collection. Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities and collaboratively with the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator, technical staff, and university stakeholders. Ability to follow established procedures, recognize incomplete information or delays, and refer issues requiring decisions to the appropriate supervisor or project lead. Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, professionalism, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.

Minimum Training & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Communications, Public Relations, English, Journalism, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. 2–4 years’ experience in communications, content development, technical writing, project support, program support, or a related area. (preferably in higher education or IT). Strong writing, editing, and communication skills. Experience with content tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, MS Publisher, or similar). Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Experience must demonstrate the ability to prepare written materials, maintain organized records, use office and collaboration applications, and complete assignments within established deadlines. Higher education or public sector experience preferred.

Conditions Of Employment

 Candidates selected for employment may be subject to medical inquiries and/or medical examination to determine ability to perform the job. Visas and labor certification will not be sponsored for this position.

Note: Position excluded from Union Representation and Collective Bargaining

Additional Job Information

 Benefits include medical, dental, prescription, long-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment insurance and life insurance; paid time for paid sick leave and annual leave; 10 paid holidays per year, tuition remission and supplemental retirement.

Wearing a face mask is required when an exemption to the influenza vaccination has been granted. HCP in violation of this directive may face disciplinary action up to and including removal from federal service. HCP are individuals who, during the influenza season, work in VHA locations or who come into contact with VA patients or other HCP as part of their duties. VHA locations include, but are not limited to, VA hospitals and associated clinics, community living centers (CLCs), community-based outpatient clinics (CBOCs), domiciliary units, Vet centers and VA-leased medical facilities. HCP include all VA licensed and unlicensed, clinical and administrative, remote and onsite, paid and without compensation, full- and part-time employees, intermittent employees, fee basis employees, VA contractors, researchers, volunteers and health professions trainees (HPTs) who are expected to perform any or all of their work at these facilities. HPTs may be paid or unpaid and include residents, interns, fellows and students. HCP also includes VHA personnel providing home-based care to Veterans and drivers and other personnel whose duties put them in contact with patients outside VA medical facilities.

partnermarketingleaderallianceschannel4c.title: Partner Marketing Leader, Alliances & Channel 4
partnermarketingleaderallianceschannel4c.description:
Stripe Marketing Leader Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.
Our mission isto increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.
That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.


The Partner Marketing team extends Stripe's marketing reach to customers and prospects by educating, engaging and enabling partners, globally, to build market awareness and generate demand for their Stripe solutions and services.
We recruit prospective partners and support the on-boarding and growth of existing partners as they build, launch, market, and scale business through the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and the Stripe platform.
We partner closely with our global partnerships, GTM partners, marketing, and product teams and serve many different partner types.


We're looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-oriented marketing leader to own Stripe's global partner marketing strategy for Services partnersincluding GSIsand Technology/ISV partners.
You'll lead a global team, define the multi-year operating and investment model, build influential relationships with partner and Stripe leaders, and scale programs that drive partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, customer activation, and product adoption.
This role requires setting a clear long-term direction while leading through others and using performance insights to focus the organization on its highest-impact opportunities.


Responsibilities Set the multi-year vision and global strategy for Services, GSI, and Technology/ISV partner marketing, translating Stripe's company, marketing, and partnerships priorities into an operating model, investment strategy, and measurable outcomes.
Lead and develop a high-performing global team of four Partner Marketing professionals across APAC, AMER, and EMEA.
Establish clear accountability, build organizational capability, evolve the team as business needs change, and ensure agencies and vendors extend the team effectively.
Build trusted relationships with partner CMOs and senior Stripe leaders.
Develop joint strategies with priority partners and align global and regional teams around shared priorities, investments, and execution.
Own a portfolio of differentiated programs for strategic partners and scalable programs for the broader ecosystem.
Integrate partners into Stripe campaigns, regional initiatives, co-sell motions, events, content, and enablement to drive pipeline, activation, and product adoption.
Shape joint value propositions, messaging, and customer evidence, and turn successful programs into reusable playbooks that can scale across partners and regions.
Establish governance for market development funds and other investments, alongside the performance framework, dashboards, and business-review cadence.
Use data and financial insight to assess impact, address underperformance, and reallocate resources toward the strongest opportunities.
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role.
If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.
The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.


Minimum requirements 15+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience, including substantial experience in partner, ecosystem, channel, or alliances marketing and a strong understanding of partner business models and indirect GTM motions.
A track record of setting and leading global marketing strategy across regions, translating company priorities into long-term plans, scalable operating models, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience building, leading, and developing a distributed team of experienced marketers, including setting direction and accountability, coaching talent, and evolving organizational capabilities through change.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives with a high degree of autonomy, build trusted relationships with partner and internal executives, and align senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Proven success delivering measurable partner-marketing outcomes and using analytical and financial judgment to manage significant budgets or market development funds, evaluate ROI, and make portfolio trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to simplify complex issues, articulate a compelling vision, and turn strategy and performance insights into clear executive recommendations and action.
Preferred qualifications Experience developing marketing strategies for Services, GSI, Technology, or ISV partners in a global, high-growth technology environment.
Experience in payments, financial technology, enterprise software, or an adjacent industry.
Breadth across partner marketing and adjacent disciplines such as demand generation, product marketing, field marketing, or integrated campaigns.
Experience managing agencies or vendors across markets and holding them accountable for quality and results.

Company Overview


Tucson Rubberized Coatings operates in the retail and manufacturing of roof coatings.


Position Summary


The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and executing marketing initiatives that support Tucson Rubberized Coatings' business objectives, brand strategy, product promotion, and customer engagement efforts. This position works closely with company leadership and cross-functional departments to plan, implement, and maintain marketing programs, advertising campaigns, product launches, digital marketing activities, and corporate communications.


The Marketing Coordinator serves as a central resource for marketing-related projects and is responsible for ensuring marketing materials, messaging, and branding are accurate, consistent, and aligned with company goals. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective project management, creativity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting the company's continued growth and market expansion.


Key Responsibilities



 Coordinate and execute marketing campaigns across print, digital, social media, email, and other marketing channels.
 Develop and coordinate product launch plans for new products and product enhancements.
 Assist in the creation, maintenance, and execution of the annual marketing plan.
 Create, edit, and proofread marketing materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand compliance.
 Coordinate the design and production of sales collateral, brochures, flyers, signage, and promotional materials.
 Support website content updates and coordinate enhancements to improve user experience and brand visibility.
 Manage social media content calendars, create engaging content, and monitor performance metrics.
 Coordinate advertising initiatives including print, digital, outdoor, radio, and television campaigns.
 Work with external vendors, designers, printers, agencies, and media partners to ensure timely project completion.
 Maintain and organize marketing assets, graphics, photography, advertising files, and brand resources.
 Support trade shows, contractor events, customer appreciation events, and community outreach activities.
 Track marketing project timelines, budgets, and campaign performance.
 Analyze marketing data and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
 Partner with sales and operations teams to ensure marketing efforts align with company objectives.
 Assist with internal communications and company-wide promotional initiatives.

Qualifications



 Associate or bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, Graphic Design, or a related field preferred.
 Minimum of 2 years of marketing, advertising, communications, or related experience preferred.
 Experience coordinating multiple projects and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Experience with digital marketing, social media management, and content creation preferred.
 Experience in manufacturing, construction, roofing, coatings, or related industries is a plus.
 Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally for events and business needs, as required.

Skills & Competencies



 Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
 Strong proofreading, editing, grammar, and copywriting abilities.
 Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to prioritize competing projects and manage deadlines effectively.
 Creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
 Strong project coordination and time management capabilities.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
 Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign preferred.
 Familiarity with website management, content management systems (CMS), and social media platforms.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple departments.
 Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing metrics and make data-driven recommendations.
 Commitment to maintaining brand standards and delivering high-quality work.

Working Conditions



 Primarily office-based environment with frequent computer and telephone use.
 Regular interaction with internal departments, customers, vendors, and contractors.
 May require occasional travel to company locations, trade shows, events, customer sites, or industry functions.
 Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use office equipment for extended periods.
 Occasionally required to lift and carry marketing materials, displays, or event supplies up to 50 pounds.
 May occasionally work outside normal business hours to support events, product launches, or special projects.

Pay: $48,000.00 - $62,000.00 per year


Work Location: In person

seniormanagerglobalpartnerecosystemmarke.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada, or the United Sates.

About The Team

The Senior Manager, Global Partner & Ecosystem Marketing is responsible for developing and executing global partner marketing programs that support strategic alliances and corporate growth objectives. This role works closely with partner marketing counterparts, regional field marketing teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and the Global Partner Organization to deliver integrated campaigns, partner engagement programs, and measurable pipeline impact across global markets.

What you will do

 Develop and execute the global partner marketing plans, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution to support established business priorities, strategic partnerships, and regional growth objectives.  Manage joint go-to-market programs across consulting partners, systems integrators, hyperscalers, VARs, and strategic technology partners.  Build strong working relationships and lead through influence across Marketing, Sales, and the Global Partner organization deliver integrated go-to-market programs.  Create scalable campaign frameworks, messaging, assets, and activation toolkits that support consistent execution across regions.  Coordinate execution across regional Field Marketing, Demand Generation, ABM, Events, Communications, Customer Marketing, and Sales teams.  Manage partner planning, campaign execution, MDF investments, partner tiering activities, and marketing standards to drive consistency and scalability across the ecosystem.  Monitor and optimize program performance through dashboards, attribution, reporting, and communicate program performance, including partner-influenced pipeline, engagement metrics, and marketing effectiveness 

What we are looking for

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  7-10 years of progressive B2B enterprise technology marketing experience, including partner, alliance, ecosystem, field, or integrated marketing experience.  Manage team workload prioritization, goal setting, and development planning while creating an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team environment.  Experience managing complex global marketing programs involving multiple partners, regions, and cross-functional stakeholders.  Strong understanding of the enterprise technology ecosystem and partner go-to-market models.  Experience developing integrated campaigns, executive engagement programs, thought leadership initiatives, and partner-supported demand generation programs.  Strong project management, stakeholder management, and budget management capabilities.  Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills within a matrixed environment.  Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, supply chain technology, or a similarly complex B2B technology environment is preferred. 

#Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)Flexible work optionsPhysical and mental well-being programsRegularly scheduled virtual fitness classesMentorship programs, training, and career developmentRecognition programs and referral rewardsHackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Summary
  This Division administers the Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act (PACA), which prohibits unfair trade practices in the marketing of fresh and frozen fruits and vegetables in interstate or foreign commerce and the Produce Agency Act (PAA). The position is located in a regional office of the division.


  Learn more about this agency


 




 
  This job is open to
 
 
  
   
    The public
   
   
    U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
   
  
  
   
    Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)
   
   
    Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.
   
  
 




 
  Duties
 
 
  The duties described are for the full-performance level. At developmental grade levels, assignments will be of more limited scope, performed with less independence and limited complexity.
  The duties may include, but are not limited to:
  Handle complex contractual disputes involved in reparation complaints through correspondence or personal contact with the parties involved.
  Conduct complex personal investigations and audits of business records.
  Conduct a range of licensing activities of firms within the region.

  Requirements
 
 Conditions of employment

  Subject to satisfactory adjudication of background investigation and/or fingerprint check.

 Qualifications
 Applicants must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of the announcement, including specialized experience and/or education, as defined below. 

FOR THE GS-07 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-05 grade level) that demonstrates:


 
  Reviewing technical documents against program standards.
  Utilizing written documentation and computer databases to prepare reports and case file information.
  Ability to interpret grading procedures and U.S. grade standards for a commodity.
 OR
 

 

  1 full year of graduate level education in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  Superior Academic Achievement: To qualify based on superior academic achievement, you must have completed the requirements for a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution AND 1) have a class standing in the upper third of the graduating class, 2) membership in a national scholastic honor society (excluding Freshman honor societies), or 3) must meet certain GPA requirements. GPA requirements: 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0 as recorded on official transcripts or as computed based on 4 years of education, or courses completed during the final 2 year of the curriculum; OR 3.5 or higher out of a possible 4.0 based on the average of the required course completed in the major field or courses completed during the final 2 years of the curriculum (GPA will be rounded to one decimal place, e.g., 2.95 rounds to 3.0 and 2.94 rounds to 2.9). 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
FOR THE GS-09 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-07 level) that may have been obtained in the private or public (local, county, state, Federal) sectors which demonstrates: 
 
  Researching laws relating to business structures, bankruptcy, and state regulatory functions.
  Collecting evidence and developing findings of investigations under license, complaint, disciplinary, and trust provisions.
  Analyzing evidence and developing findings and recommendations resulting from investigations involving licensing, complaint, disciplinary, and trust provisions.
 OR
 

 

  Master's or equivalent graduate degree in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  LL.B. or J.D., if related. 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
FOR THE GS-11 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-09 level) that may have been obtained in the private or public (local, county, state, Federal) sectors which demonstrates: 
 
  Applying business procedures, laws, and regulations, relating to business structures, bankruptcy, and state regulatory functions.
  Developing regulatory documents to describe, justify, and establish legal requirements.
  Reviewing, researching, and analyzing industry proposals, economic, or business data.
 OR
 

 

  Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  LL.M., if related 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
TRANSCRIPTS are required if: 
 
  You are qualifying for the position based on education.
  You are qualifying for this position based on a combination of experience and education.
  You are qualifying for this position based on Superior Academic Achievement.
  This education must have been successfully completed and obtained from an accredited school, college, or university.
 COMBINATION OF EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE AT THE GS-7/9/11 GRADE LEVEL: Applicants may have combinations of successfully completed education and specialized experience to meet total qualification requirements. The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify for that grade level. 
 

 

  Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. 
 


 
  Education
  Please see above for education qualification requirement information.


 
 
  Additional information

corporatemarketingdirectorcapitalequipme.title: Corporate Marketing Director - Capital Equipment
corporatemarketingdirectorcapitalequipme.description:
We are working with a publicly traded capital equipment and technology organization in Tempe that is looking for a Corporate Marketing Director.




This is a broad, hands-on marketing leadership role for someone who understands complex technical products, engineering-driven customers, and B2B capital equipment markets. The Director will work closely with the CEO, business-unit leaders, sales, engineering, and other stakeholders to strengthen the company’s overall market position and create a more consistent story across multiple products and businesses.




This is an individual-contributor role today. The right person needs to be comfortable setting the strategy, influencing senior leaders, and personally driving the work.




What You’ll Do

Develop and strengthen the company’s overall positioning, messaging, and corporate brand.Partner with business-unit leaders, sales, and technical teams to develop product and portfolio positioning.Translate complex product features and technical capabilities into clear customer benefits and value propositions.Bring multiple product lines and business units together under a consistent company story.Develop messaging and materials for customers, executives, industry events, presentations, and other external audiences.Support go-to-market strategy, product launches, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and market research.Own and improve corporate marketing materials, website messaging, presentations, collateral, and brand standards.Support trade shows and industry events, including development of messaging, presentations, and supporting materials.Partner with outside resources supporting investor relations, communications, design, and other marketing initiatives.Work directly with senior leadership and influence stakeholders across the organization without relying on direct authority.


What We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive experience in product marketing, strategic marketing, technical marketing, or marketing communications within a technical B2B environment.Strong preference for experience in semiconductor equipment, semiconductor materials, capital equipment, advanced manufacturing, industrial technology, electronics, scientific instrumentation, or related technical markets.Ability to understand technical products and comfortably work with engineers, sales leaders, product experts, and technical customers.Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.Strong understanding of how technical B2B customers evaluate products and make purchasing decisions.Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge existing thinking, and drive organizational change.Strong executive presence, communication skills, and storytelling ability.Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a lean organization.Bachelor’s degree required. An engineering, technical, business, or related degree is strongly preferred.Experience in semiconductor or capital equipment markets is highly preferred.


The Environment

This is not a traditional large-company marketing role with highly specialized teams supporting every function. The Director will have significant ownership and visibility and will work across the organization to gather information, develop recommendations, and drive execution.

The ideal person is someone who understands technical markets, is naturally curious, can earn credibility with engineers and commercial leaders, and has the conviction to challenge existing approaches when there is a better way to position the company.

In this role, you'll help expand WingBud's visibility and audience engagement while also supporting our mission of helping clients build stronger communication, networking, and social skills. Track and analyze engagement metrics (reach, follower growth, post performance, event attendance) and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement
Collaborate with the team on brainstorming and executing new marketing strategies
Support and occasionally co-facilitate one-on-one and small-group client sessions focused on communication confidence, public speaking, and social engagement
Serve as a role model for professionalism, communication excellence, and inclusive social dynamics across all WingBud programming

Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and content creation best practices
Experience with or strong interest in digital marketing (paid or organic)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Reliable, energetic, adaptable, and professional demeanor

Educational Preferences/Requirements



Currently enrolled as a college student (any year/major considered; marketing, communications, or related fields preferred)

marketingmanagercorporaterpmliving.description:
About the position

The Corporate Marketing Manager is a key stakeholder in developing RPM Living’s corporate marketing strategy and manages corporate marketing projects, programs, and activities. The role contributes to the corporate brand narrative and marketing strategy and support for operational specialties, with the goal of increasing brand awareness and strengthening RPM’s position as an industry leader. It calls for strong account and project management, strategic thinking, and the ability to align cross-functional teams.\n\nThe manager leads corporate marketing initiatives, plans and executes campaigns, coordinates project resources and stakeholders, and collaborates with creative and communications teams on internal branding and communication. The role also manages cross-functional workflows, provides marketing strategy and recommendations, communicates campaign plans and results, and resolves prioritization issues. It evaluates corporate marketing performance and return on investment, and partners with board members, executive leadership, operations, and vendors to align marketing work with company standards, vision, and organizational priorities. This is a hybrid position requiring work in a corporate or regional office four days per week. Travel is less than 30%.

Responsibilities

Lead corporate marketing initiatives that support business objectives and serve as the client-facing lead for assigned internal and external stakeholders.Plan and execute campaign strategies, plans, and tactics for internal and external initiatives; monitor and communicate project details and ensure work is completed on time and to a high standard.Partner with creative and communications teams on internal branding and communications that support change management, align with company vision, and engage associates.Collaborate with creative services, communications, and other teams to develop and deliver project resources.Promote a consistent customer experience across internal departments, regions, and clients in marketing support.Manage cross-functional projects from planning through completion, including scope, budgets, schedules, resources, assets, deliverables, workflow, and conflict resolution.Manage daily workflow and project priorities across multiple departments.Review ad hoc requests and content from internal departments and business leaders, and provide relevant marketing and communications strategy or recommendations.Communicate and present campaign information, deadlines, release dates, and results to internal and external stakeholders.Lead regular internal meetings for corporate marketing projects and communicate expectations.Troubleshoot project or campaign prioritization conflicts and elevate issues when needed.Collect performance data, ROI results, and anecdotal feedback to prepare actionable post-campaign evaluations and reporting.Build and maintain partnerships with board members, executive leadership, operations, and vendor partners to ensure company standards and vision are consistently represented.Work with senior leadership to align organizational priorities and stakeholder objectives, producing alignment documents and creative briefs.Research and recommend new marketing opportunities and channels.Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.At least 2 years of experience in a marketing-related field.Proven track record of success in developing and executing enterprise communications strategies.Ability to travel less than 30%.Nice-to-haves

Experience in the multifamily housing industry.Valid driver’s license preferred.Benefits

Comprehensive healthcare coverage for full-time, regular associates.Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs.Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance.401(k) with company match.Professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans.Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging programs and Employee Resource Groups.Paid time off, floating holidays, and volunteer days.Discounts on Costco membership, movie tickets, health and wellness, entertainment, and travel.Weekly pay for associates working onsite at an apartment community.

The ideal candidate is outgoing, adaptable, and eager to develop practical marketing experience. No previous marketing experience is required, as training will be provided. • Represent assigned brands, products, and services during customer-facing activities.
• Introduce promotional offerings to prospective customers through direct conversations.
• Communicate key marketing messages clearly and consistently.

• Friendly, confident, and professional approach to customer interactions.
• Comfortable initiating conversations with new people.
• Ability to communicate product information and promotional messaging clearly.
• Strong listening skills and interest in understanding customer needs.
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn new marketing techniques.
• Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
