seniorcommunicationsspecialisttailscale.title: Senior Communications Specialist
seniorcommunicationsspecialisttailscale.description:
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications.


We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are.
From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more.
We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be.
We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function.
This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.

Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure.
We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure.
We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO.
You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.

Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage.
It could also include research-led PR.

Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.

Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.

Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.

Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence.
Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.

Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.

Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation.
Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement.
Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.

10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.

~ Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.

~ Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.

~ Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.

~ Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.

~ Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.

~ Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement.

~ A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.


Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.

Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.

Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.

Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.

Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary.
An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.


This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
Remote first company -most of our teams work fully remotely.
Enjoy a change of scen.

mediarelationsspecialistatbigvoicecommun.title: Media Relations Specialist at Big Voice Communications, LLC - New Haven, Connecticut
mediarelationsspecialistatbigvoicecommun.description:
ABOUT BIG VOICE COMMUNICATIONS

Big Voice Communications is a women-owned strategic communications and public relations firm in New Haven, Connecticut. We are a small, strategic team that punches above its weight for a national roster of nonprofits. Since 2005, we have helped clients earn attention for the work that matters to them, from health and education to public safety and the arts. If you like variety, real ownership of your work, and colleagues who care about doing it well, you will fit in here.



Are you ready to apply Make sure you understand all the responsibilities and tasks associated with this role before proceeding.


THE ROLE

Reports to: Principal / Account Director

Employment type: Full-time, exempt

Location: New Haven, Connecticut area (in a small-office environment; flexible hours considered)




Our Media Relations Specialist partners with account and client leaders to build media and influencer strategies that earn coverage for our clients. This person is a capable communications professional who develops sharp pitches and press materials, exercises sound judgment across a wide range of tasks, and brings a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage across a wide variety of channels for a wide variety of clients. Success in this role means continually being creative to turn client expertise into earned media that reaches the right audiences.




Please note: This is an earned media role. Candidates must demonstrate a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage in a wide variety of channels -- print, broadcast, online, trade and podcast -- for a wide variety of clients. Experience limited to social media or to working as a journalist does not meet this requirement.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Identify and create opportunities to place client stories across traditional, digital, and influencer channels

• Continually bring fresh story ideas to the team 

• Write and pitch stories that showcase our clients' thought leadership

• Develop compelling, media-ready content including press releases, op-eds, bylines, pitches, media advisories and messaging

• Identify vertical pitching opportunities for clients in trade publications, national and regional media as well as bloggers, influencers and podcast hosts

• Track and foster relationships with beat reporters who cover niche topics relevant to client portfolios

• Recommend and track earned media efforts

• Coordinate and monitor interviews and prepare clients

• Monitor the news daily to surface timely opportunities for clients

• Participate in client meetings and contribute to strategic planning

• Collaborate across multiple client teams and pivot quickly as priorities shift




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in communications, English or journalism

• Two to four years of related experience in public relations, media relations or communications

• Must demonstrate a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage in a wide variety of channels (print, broadcast, online, trade and podcast) for a wide variety of clients

• A strong portfolio of earned media placements you secured for multiple clients

• Social media experience alone or journalism experience alone does not qualify

• Excellent writing and editing skills with a creative, engaging voice

• Working knowledge of earned media, including building media lists and plans

• Strong presentation skills and the confidence to offer sound counsel to clients

• Ability to organize and manage multiple projects at once

• Meticulous attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Stays informed of new and emerging channels and tools that secure earned media

• Resourceful, effective problem-solving skills

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and media relations tools such as Cision

• Comfort using social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and X




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with media monitoring and analytics tools

• General knowledge of photography, video or audio editing

• Bilingual is a bonus!




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Big Voice Communications offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, along with benefits such as health and dental coverage, paid time off, 401K and flexible scheduling. 




WORK HOURS AND TRAVEL

Hours: Full-time. In-office

Travel: Limited travel two to four times a year.




TO APPLY

Please send a resume, cover letter to  . Please include your full name in the file name of each document.




Big Voice Communications believes in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion. We strive to recruit a diverse group of candidates to help us achieve that goal. Big Voice Communications is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, disability status, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the position

Banana Republic is seeking a dynamic, experienced Manager to support and continuously develop and optimize its CRM and retention strategies. This data-driven, customer-focused role is part of the CRM Retention marketing team, which works to understand customer behaviors that drive long-term value, loyalty, and engagement, and to identify opportunities for personalization across the customer lifecycle.\n\nThe Manager owns the lifecycle roadmap and triggered-program portfolio across Email, SMS, and Push for Banana Republic Specialty and Factory. The role prioritizes high-value customer moments, coordinates lifecycle programs across channels, and partners with batch-communications teams to ensure customers receive appropriate messages. It also owns program-level reporting, performance diagnosis, test planning and recommendations, and contributes to customer-level contact strategy and personalization.\n\nThe position executes program builds, launches, and quality assurance in partnership with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, technology, and vendor partners. It also manages the retention Direct Mail program end to end, from audience selection and creative briefing through execution and measurement of incrementality and ROI.

Own the lifecycle roadmap and triggered-program portfolio across Email, SMS, and Push, including behavioral triggers, post-purchase and order communications, low-in-stock messaging, and loyalty programs across Banana Republic Specialty and Factory.Prioritize high-value customer moments and decide which programs to build, scale, fix, or stop.Coordinate lifecycle programs across Email, SMS, and Push, and partner with batch-communications teams so communications complement one another.Own program-level performance reporting; diagnose year-over-year and week-over-week changes and distinguish efficiency gains from mix shifts, volume effects, attributed demand, and incremental demand.Reconcile data across sources and validate figures before sharing them with leadership.Translate performance results into clear business implications for senior leaders, including what happened, why it matters, and recommended actions.Build and run a testing agenda focused on incrementality, customer-message fit, and productive communication volume; interpret results and recommend whether to scale, modify, or stop programs.Help shape customer-level communication decisions when customers qualify for multiple messages, evaluating demand, engagement, and file health together.Partner with analytics and CRM teams to deepen personalization where it creates measurable value.Manage program builds, launches, and quality assurance end to end with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, and technology and vendor partners.Manage timelines, hold partners accountable, and escalate issues early with a recommendation.Manage the retention Direct Mail program end to end, including audience selection, creative briefing, execution, and measurement of incrementality and ROI.Requirements

Experience in retail or e-commerce.SQL.Adobe Analytics.

acquisitionmarketingmanagerclientsblackb.title: Acquisition Marketing Manager
acquisitionmarketingmanagerclientsblackb.description:
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.


 We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.


 We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Paid Media Strategist / Account Strategist who can own client accounts from strategy through execution.


  The Opportunity
 This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.


 You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.


  What You'll Own
  Client Strategy & Relationships


 
  Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact
  Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, priorities, and next steps
  Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
  Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical clients
  Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
  Solve account issues proactively to support stability and growth
 
  Meta Campaign Management


 
  Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
  Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables
  Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
  Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
  Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
  Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging
 
  Tracking & Technical Execution


 
  Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
  Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
  Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
  Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results
 
 
 Requirements
 

 


 
  4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
  Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
  Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
  Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
  Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
 
  Preferred Experience


 
  Financial services marketing
  Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
  Video sales letter marketing
  High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
  Direct-response advertising
 
  How You Work
 You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.


 You're organized, detail-oriented, and able to move quickly across multiple accounts without losing sight of the outcome. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people sharing responsibility for it.



   Benefits
 

 


 
  Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
  Training & Development
  Work From Home
  Flexible Schedule
  Performance Bonus

srregionalmarketingmanagermarketingopera.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Field marketing teams move fast — but only as fast as their infrastructure allows. The Marketing Operations & Field Programs Manager is the person who builds and maintains that infrastructure. This role owns the vendor ecosystem that supports field execution: identifying the right partners, running a rigorous onboarding process, managing procurement relationships, and holding vendors to clear performance and compliance standards over time. When a Market Activation Manager needs a local canvassing partner, a print fulfillment vendor, or a promotional materials supplier, this role is why a qualified, contracted option already exists — rather than requiring a ground-up sourcing process every time.

Beyond vendor management, this role owns the operational capabilities that make the field team more effective at scale: the creative asset repository that gives every market consistent, brand-compliant materials; the swag and collateral ordering tools that remove friction from local activations; and the operational processes that keep field programs running cleanly across a distributed, high-volume team. This is an enablement role — its measure of success is how smoothly the field executes, not how visible the work behind it is.

Working Conditions

— Travel required: This is a remote role with occasional travel for vendor site visits, field team onboarding, or program activations.

— Cross-functional coordination with procurement, legal, finance, and the broader Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team.

— Operational pace is steady-state with periodic intensity around vendor onboarding, new campaign launches, and/or capability rollouts.


Job Responsibilities

Vendor Management & Onboarding

— Vendor Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end process for identifying, evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors that support field marketing execution — including canvassing partners, event staffing agencies, print and fulfillment vendors, promotional merchandise suppliers, and local media partners.

— Onboarding Standards: Develop and maintain clear criteria for why a vendor gets brought on: capability fit, geographic coverage, pricing benchmarks, compliance requirements, diversity and inclusion considerations, and track record. Document those standards so decisions are defensible and repeatable.

— Vendor Performance: Manage active vendor relationships — conduct regular performance reviews, track SLA compliance, resolve issues before they become field disruptions, and make recommendations on continuation, expansion, or termination.

— Procurement Partnership: Serve as the primary liaison between the field marketing team and T-Mobile's procurement function — managing SOWs, POs, and contract renewals in partnership with legal and procurement, and keeping field leaders informed on vendor status and timelines.

— Vendor Registry: Maintain a vendor registry that gives the field team a clear, current view of approved partners by category and geography — so MAMs and Regional Field Leads aren't sourcing ad hoc.

Field Capabilities & Tools

— Creative Repository: Own the creative asset repository — the centralized library where field teams access brand-approved templates, campaign materials, photography, copy guides, and customizable collateral. Keep it current, organized, and actually usable.

— Swag & Collateral Tools: Manage swag and promotional merchandise ordering systems — from vendor selection to ordering platform configuration to fulfillment tracking. The field team should be able to order what they need without a manual workaround.

— Capability Development: Identify operational friction points in how the field team accesses tools, materials, and vendor support — and build the processes or systems to remove them. This includes onboarding new MAMs and Regional Field Leads to available capabilities.

— Scaling Support: Partner with the broader Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team to scope and implement new operational capabilities as the field program scales — evaluating new tools, platforms, and vendor categories as needs evolve.

Budget Management

— Team Budget Ownership: Own the Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team budget — managing total spend across vendor contracts, field programs, creative production, tools, and collateral against plan.

— Budget Tracking: Build and maintain a monthly budget tracker with visibility into committed spend, forecasted spend, and remaining budget by category — giving the Sr. Manager and broader leadership team a clear, current picture at all times.

— Finance Partnership: Partner with finance on budget cycles, reforecasts, and end-of-quarter reconciliations. Flag variances early with a clear explanation and a recommended path forward — not a surprise at month-end.

— Vendor Spend Management: Manage vendor spend against contracted SOWs — tracking invoices, approving POs, and ensuring the team operates within budget without sacrificing field readiness.

Process & Compliance

— SOPs: Establish and document standard operating procedures for how the field team engages vendors, orders materials, manages field program budgets, and reports spend — reducing inconsistency across markets.

— Policy Compliance: Ensure all vendor relationships and field program expenditures comply with T-Mobile procurement policies, brand standards, and any applicable regulatory requirements — and that the field team has the guidance they need to stay compliant.


Qualifications

— Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience. Or, advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience. Or, combination of education and experience deemed equivalent

— 4+ years in marketing operations, vendor management, field programs, or a related role with direct responsibility for procurement partnerships and operational process design.

— Experience managing vendor relationships end-to-end — from sourcing and onboarding through contract management and performance review.

— Demonstrated ability to build and maintain operational processes in a distributed or field-based environment.

— Comfortable navigating corporate procurement processes — SOWs, POs, vendor compliance requirements — and translating those requirements for field-facing teams.

— Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple vendor relationships and operational workstreams simultaneously.

— Experience in telecom, broadband, or a consumer business with a field sales or local marketing component preferred.

— Familiarity with creative asset management platforms, swag/merchandise ordering tools, or field enablement systems preferred.

— Background in field marketing, event marketing, or brand activation — understands what field teams actually need operationally preferred.

— Experience working with legal and procurement on vendor contracts and compliance documentation preferred.

— At least 18 years of age

— Legally authorized to work in the United States

 onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a continued focus on the automotive and industrial end-markets, onsemi is accelerating change and driving disruptive innovation towards a sustainable ecosystem in high-growth megatrends such as vehicle electrification, advanced safety, alternative energy, and factory automation. communicationssystemsengineeropticalquan.description:
Description 
 SAIC is seeking a Communications Systems Engineer with strong optical and quantum communications engineering experience to support specialized analysis, engineering, design, and operations for Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of War (DoW) customers. We support development of next-generation and far-future national security systems across land, sea, air, and space domains.
  We are hiring a Communications Systems Engineer to provide systems engineering and technical advisory (SETA) support to an IC Research & Development (R&D) customer developing advanced hardware, software, and architectural solutions for mission-critical optical and quantum communication systems. 
  Responsibilities 
 • Perform technical reviews, assessments, and risk evaluations of optical and quantum communication system development efforts at the component, subsystem, system, and architecture levels. 
 • Evaluate designs and technologies including optical terminals, free-space optical links, photonic components, entanglement-based communication architectures, and quantum-enhanced optical subsystems. 
 • Assess emerging technologies and identify gaps related to high-bandwidth space links, advanced modulation formats, pointing/tracking systems, link budgets, networking performance, and secure quantum-enabled transport architectures. 
 • Support development of technology roadmaps, requirements, specifications, verification approaches, and transition strategies for optical and quantum system modernization. 
 • Conduct technical outreach with mission users to capture needs and evaluate applicability of emerging optical and quantum capabilities. 
 • Prepare system engineering documentation, technical analyses, and program-level briefings to communicate findings and strategic recommendations. 
 • Provide support to programmatic and acquisition activities, including source selections, lifecycle documentation, and system integration planning. 
  
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or related discipline and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience
• Experience with USG program management and acquisition lifecycle processes and documentation.
• Strong interpersonal, verbal, and technical writing communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.
Desired Qualifications 
• Master's degree in engineering, physics, or related discipline.
• 12+ years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years in optical or quantum communication systems.
• 1+ year of experience supporting USG R&D acquisition processes and documentation.
• Experience with space-based optical terminals, quantum optical payloads, photonic systems, or advanced quantum-enhanced communication architectures
 
  
 Target salary range: $160,001 - $200,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

eventsmarketingcoordinatorarrivia.description:
We're looking for an organized, proactive Events & Marketing Coordinator to bring consumer travel events to life and support the marketing that keeps customers connected. If you enjoy coordinating people, managing details, and seeing a plan come together onsite, this role offers hands-on ownership with room to grow.




This is an onsite position based in Tucson, Arizona, with local travel required for events.



About the Role




Events are the primary focus, from a large annual travel show to smaller supplier presentations and online webinars. You will coordinate free, consumer-facing events that bring multiple travel suppliers together, managing the details from planning and promotion through setup, execution, and follow-up.




Between seasonal event peaks, you will support marketing campaigns and social media activity. This combined role is ideal for someone with practical event coordination experience or an early-career candidate who has managed meaningful events through internships, hospitality, campus organizations, or community activities.



What You'll Own







 Event Planning: Coordinate consumer travel shows, supplier presentations, and smaller events, keeping timelines, task lists, and communications organized.
 Supplier and Venue Coordination: Work with travel suppliers, venues, vendors, and internal teams to bring multiple participants together for a well-run event.
 Onsite Execution: Handle setup, registration, signage, materials, onsite coordination, and breakdown, helping guests and suppliers have a positive experience.
 Supplier Webinars: Coordinate online events, including scheduling, promotional materials, participant communications, and follow-up.
 Event Promotion: Support invitations, email communications, and promotional content that encourage attendance at our free events.
 Results and Follow-Up: Track attendance, expenses, and event outcomes, and keep post-event communications and next steps moving.
 Marketing Support: Help coordinate campaigns, creative assets, approvals, and deadlines across email, web, print, and other channels.
 Social Media: Create and schedule event-related and brand content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and monitor engagement.
 Quality and Organization: Proofread materials, check details, and maintain calendars so marketing work and event deadlines stay on track.




What You'll Bring





 Event planning or coordination experience, whether gained professionally, through internships, or through substantial campus or community involvement.
 Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage several deadlines and changing priorities.
 Clear, professional communication with suppliers, vendors, customers, and colleagues.
 A dependable, hands-on approach. You are comfortable handling both the planning and the practical work that makes an event successful.
 Some familiarity with marketing and social media. Broader campaign experience is a plus, but event coordination is the priority.
 Attention to detail and confidence proofreading customer-facing materials.
 Comfort using everyday business software and learning new marketing, webinar, and social media tools.
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, Hospitality, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
 Reliable transportation for local event travel, including Tucson, Green Valley, Oro Valley, and occasional Phoenix-area events.
 Availability to occasionally work outside standard business hours for events.
 Ability to lift, carry, or move event materials and boxes weighing up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.




Who We Are



arrivia powers travel loyalty and rewards programs for some of the world's leading brands. We connect travelers with memorable experiences through the technology, supplier relationships, and service that support our partners.




Bon Voyage Travel is proud to be part of the arrivia family of brands. Together, we connect travelers with exceptional vacation experiences, including cruises, resorts, and tour packages.



Our Core Values





 Stay Curious: Explore new challenges and make space to learn, grow, and improve.

Your browser cookies must be enabled in order to apply for this job. Please contact support@jobscore.com if you need further instruction on how to do that.

Content and Digital Campaign Manager

MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS | Tucson, AZ Headquarters | Full Time | Opened 28 days ago

Job Description

Hexagon's Mining division is seeking a Content and Digital Campaign Manager to develop compelling content and lead digital campaigns that engage audiences, generate demand, and support global business priorities.

This is a hands-on role with equal responsibility for content strategy and creation (50%) and digital campaign management (50%). You will turn complex ideas, customer challenges, and technology into clear, engaging narratives, while planning, executing, and optimising targeted digital campaigns. Both disciplines are core to the role: creating relevant content and ensuring it reaches the right audiences to strengthen our brand, engage customers, and generate demand.

Your content remit spans video, digital and social formats, with a strong emphasis on visual storytelling, from story development and scripting through filming, editing, and distribution. Your campaign remit spans audience targeting, channel planning, campaign delivery, lead nurturing, testing, and performance optimisation. Across both, you will align audience needs, the customer journey, and business objectives to create content that drives engagement and conversion.

You will work with global customers and partners, collaborating with the brand & comms team, regional marketing and product marketing, to align content and digital campaigns with business priorities.

You will have considerable autonomy to identify content opportunities, develop ideas, and manage content projects and digital campaigns from brief and production through launch, measurement, and ongoing optimisation.

Job responsibilities

Content strategy and creation - 50%

Support the development and execution of content strategies aligned with marketing, communications, product, campaign, and business priorities.Identify strong stories and translate complex technical and business subjects into clear, audience-focused content.Develop content across multiple formats and channels, including video, customer stories, articles, campaign content, product marketing materials, social media, and digital platforms.Lead video projects from concept to delivery, including research, story development, scripting and storyboarding, filming, editing, distribution, and measurement.Work directly with customers, subject-matter experts, product managers, sales teams, executives, and marketing colleagues to uncover insights and develop credible, relevant stories.Apply strong copywriting and editorial judgement to ensure content is concise, engaging, accurate, and appropriate for its intended audience.Ensure content aligns with Hexagon''s brand identity, messaging, product positioning, and tone of voice.Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and optimise existing content across channels and audiences, prioritising quality and relevance over volume.Use content and campaign performance data to understand audience engagement, assess effectiveness, and recommend improvements.Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, from initial brief through stakeholder review, production, publication, and measurement.Manage external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when specialist skills or additional capacity are required.Contribute ideas and recommendations that help evolve Hexagon Mining''s content and video strategy.Digital campaign management - 50%

Plan, execute, and optimise integrated digital campaigns aligned with business priorities, working with regional marketing to define target audiences, objectives, channel plans, timelines, and success measures.Manage campaign delivery across email, web, paid digital, and social channels, coordinating internal specialists and external partners to ensure timely execution and a consistent customer experience.Develop campaign messaging, content, landing pages, and calls to action that connect audience needs with clear next steps across the customer journey.Manage our CRM and Marketing Automation platform to support audience segmentation, lead capture, nurture programmes, and timely lead handover and follow-up.Monitor campaign performance against agreed engagement, conversion, and demand-generation measures; test messaging, creative, and landing pages, and translate results into practical improvements.Track spend and results, and recommend adjustments to improve campaign efficiency and effectiveness.Knowledge and Experience - Required:

8+ years of professional marketing experience, with demonstrated hands-on capability in both content strategy and creation and digital campaign management, preferably within a B2B, technology, industrial, engineering, or similarly complex environment.A Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.Portfolio demonstrating both high-quality content, including video production and editing, and digital campaigns, with clear examples of campaign objectives, execution, optimisation, and measurable results.Strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with the ability to find the human and business story within complex or technical subject matter.Experience working in mining, technology, industrial, engineering, or another complex B2B environment.Demonstrated experience developing content and independently planning, executing, and optimising integrated digital campaigns across email, web, paid digital, and social channels.Practical video production experience, including storyboarding, scripting, filming, and editing.Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software, with the ability to adapt to Premiere Pro.Practical experience with marketing automation, email campaign platforms, website or landing-page tools, and CRM systems to support segmentation, lead capture, nurture programmes, and lead handover.Ability to interpret campaign analytics, track engagement and conversion, conduct A/B testing, and translate findings into improvements to messaging, targeting, creative, and landing pages.Strong project management skills, with the ability to balance content production and campaign delivery, coordinate stakeholders and specialist partners, and manage schedules, spend, and reporting.Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

Experience creating content in collaboration with customers and turning customer experiences into compelling stories.Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or production vendors across different markets.Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud beyond Premiere Pro, including tools such as After Effects, Photoshop, or Audition.Photography and on-location video production experience.Experience using marketing and customer data to understand customer behaviour, identify audience or content insights, and inform content strategy and decision-making.Experience analysing content performance and translating data into practical recommendations for future content and campaigns.Spanish or Portuguese language skills alongside professional-level English.Formal education in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline.Travel

International travel, including travel to customer and mine sites may be required.What success looks like

Success will be assessed equally across content and digital campaign management. For content, you will deliver accurate, engaging, audience-focused work that supports agreed business priorities, meets brand standards, and is delivered on time, with performance assessed through relevant engagement and content-use measures. For campaigns, you will deliver against agreed objectives, schedules, and budgets, using engagement, lead generation, conversion, and nurture performance to assess effectiveness and guide ongoing optimisation.

You will move confidently between storytelling and campaign execution: developing a customer story or filming on location, then bringing content into targeted campaigns and using performance insights to improve results. Most importantly, you will connect what we create with how it reaches and engages the right audiences, balancing both responsibilities rather than treating campaigns as an extension of content production.

About Hexagon

Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems.

Hexagon''s Mining division connects the physical and digital worlds of a mine, helping customers make better-informed decisions across the mining lifecycle. Our technologies support safer operations, improved productivity, and better use of resources from mine planning and operations through to processing.

Job Title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator


About My Better Balcony: My Better Balcony is an outdoor furniture company specializing in balcony tables and hanging planters. We started My Better Balcony in 2025 and are currently focused on growing our brand, expanding our customer base, and building a strong presence through social media and digital marketing.


Position Overview — We’re looking for a creative, motivated, and independent marketing student to help grow My Better Balcony's social media presence and overall brand awareness. This position will involve developing content in-person, generating marketing ideas, researching potential opportunities, and helping create strategies to reach new customers.


Because My Better Balcony is a growing company, this position offers the opportunity to take initiative, contribute your own ideas, and have a direct impact on the company's marketing efforts.


Responsibilities may include:




Assisting with the development and management of social media content




Creating and brainstorming content ideas for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook




Helping plan, film, and edit photo and video content




Researching marketing trends, competitors, and potential customers




Identifying opportunities to increase brand awareness and reach new audiences




Assisting with advertising and promotional campaigns




Providing creative ideas and recommendations for growing the My Better Balcony brand




Qualifications / Preferred Skills: We’re searching for a current ASU marketing student who lives in the Tempe area. Ideally, this person has an understanding of social media marketing and is comfortable working within e-commerce platforms such as the My Better Balcony Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, Ebay, etc.


The ideal candidate should be:




Creative and comfortable contributing new ideas




Interested in social media, marketing, and brand development




Able to work independently and take initiative




Comfortable communicating with businesses and other organizations




Located in or near the Tempe area




Experience with photography, videography, video editing, graphic design, Canva, Meta advertising, or other digital marketing tools is preferred but not required.


Schedule & Pay: The expected schedule for this position is up to 10 hours per week (flexible with school schedule). You’ll have flexibility in deciding when you complete your work, although certain in-person activities or meetings may need to be scheduled in advance.


Compensation: $20 per hour.


Location / Remote vs. In-Person: This position will involve a combination of remote and in-person work. The amount of in-person work may vary depending on the social media content and marketing activities being developed. More time may occasionally need to be allocated to in-person work to create the desired photo and video content.


What They'll Gain — Since My Better Balcony is a relatively new company and our products have only recently been released; this is a great opportunity to take initiative and play a meaningful role in helping grow the company.


You’ll gain hands-on experience in social media marketing, content creation, brand development, outreach, and other aspects of growing a business. You will also have opportunities to work directly with the company, communicate with different businesses and organizations, and contribute ideas that can have a real impact on sales and the future direction of the brand.


Most importantly, you’ll have a valuable section to put on your resume along with a strong reference that you can use in the future.


How to Apply: If you’re interested in the position, please reach out to mybetterbalcony@gmail.com and tell us a little about yourself, your marketing experience or interests, and why you are interested in working with My Better Balcony.

The Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for managing and improving the performance of Desert Financial Credit Union’s owned digital channels, including the website, email, digital advertising, ATMs, digital signage, online banking, digital applications, and other member-facing digital experiences. This role contributes to the planning and execution of digital creative initiatives, helping ensure a consistent, user-friendly, and engaging experience across all digital touchpoints.


The position blends creative craft with a digital-first, mobile-first, user-centered performance mindset, ensuring every asset and experience is on-brand, intuitive, and optimized for the channel it lives in. This is a hands-on role responsible for both design production and cross-functional collaboration. The Digital Marketing Specialist ensures that monthly creative deliverables are published on schedule. 


This role works within Digital Marketing and maintains a partnership with the Creative Team to ensure alignment with brand standards, creative quality, and design best practices.


What you will do here:


Digital Design and Production


Leverage AI-powered productivity tools to scale creative output, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market across digital deliverables


Read and analyze performance data for creative and provide recommendations for optimization


Design and produce digital assets across owned and paid channels, including but not limited to online banking ads, website pages, email templates, and digital ads


Manage digital advertising on owned channels, including online and mobile banking platforms, digital signage and other systems as needed


Apply UI/UX best practices to design intuitive, user-centered digital experiences that improve usability and conversion


Create responsive, mobile-first prototype/designs in programs like Figma optimized for performance across devices, screen sizes, and email/web rendering environments


Prepare, optimize, and deploy assets, ensuring proper file formats, specs, and quality across platforms


Collaboration and Project Execution


Partner with web developers, lifecycle/marketing automation, designers, content, and channel strategy teams to deliver design assets that are production-ready and technically feasible


Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and incorporate user feedback and usability findings into design iterations


Manage and organize digital design files and assets within the team’s digital asset management and file systems


Design Systems and Brand Consistency


Build and maintain reusable design components, UI/UX patterns, templates, and layouts that support speed to market and brand consistency across digital touchpoints


Ensure all creative adheres to brand standards, legal/compliance requirements, and disclosure guidelines for financial services marketing


Design with accessibility in mind, applying inclusive design principles and supporting accessibility standards across digital deliverables


Testing, Optimization, and Iteration


Support A/B testing and experimentation by developing creative variants, analyzing results, identifying performance trends, and recommending design and experience optimizations based on data and insights


Apply usability testing and user research findings to continuously improve the member experience across digital properties


Stay current on digital design, UI/UX, and accessibility trends, tools, and best practices, bringing fresh ideas to elevate the member experience


Perform other job duties as required. 


What you will need:


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, or another related field preferred.


Equivalent combination of experience and education required.


4+ years of professional design experience, with a focus on digital deliverables (web, email, digital ads) and UI/UX design required.


Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and digital analytics, including analyzing website traffic, user behavior, engagement, conversion paths, and campaign performance required.


Ability to interpret digital performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations for creative, UI/UX, content, and conversion optimization required.


Proficiency with Figma or similar tools required.


Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud required.


Portfolio demonstrating strong digital design and UI/UX skills across multiple channels and formats required.


Strong understanding of digital marketing, measurement, and conversion optimization principles, including A/B testing, KPI analysis, campaign performance, and data-informed design optimization required.


Working knowledge of designing for digital environments, including responsive/mobile-first design and email/web constraints required.


Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, and UI/UX principles required.


Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment required.


Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, web, and creative teams required.


Experience with prototyping and usability testing tools and methods preferred.


Experience designing within a CMS and/or marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Optimizely, HubSpot) preferred.


Familiarity with basic HTML/CSS as it relates to email and web design preferred.


Experience with motion graphics and/or animation preferred.


Experience working in a regulated industry (e.g., financial services) preferred.


We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

Position: Marketing & Communications Manager


Position Summary


Marketing & Communications Manager is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing marketing initiatives across multiple motorcycle and powersports dealership locations and brands. This position oversees digital marketing, social media management, content creation, promotional campaigns, brand development, event planning, and advertising strategy.


The primary objective is to increase brand awareness, drive dealership traffic, generate qualified sales and service leads, promote inventory, and strengthen customer engagement through consistent and creative marketing efforts.


Key Responsibilities1. Digital Marketing & Advertising



 Develop, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and other digital advertising platforms.
 Create targeted advertising campaigns to promote new and used inventory, manufacturer incentives, dealership promotions, parts, accessories, and service departments.
 Research and implement relevant keywords, search themes, audience targeting, and geographic targeting.
 Monitor advertising performance, budgets, campaign effectiveness, and lead generation.
 Coordinate manufacturer advertising requirements and manage co-op advertising submissions and reimbursement documentation.
 Evaluate advertising performance and identify opportunities to improve return on investment.

2. Social Media Management



 Manage and maintain social media accounts across multiple dealership brands and locations.
 Develop content calendars and maintain consistent posting schedules.
 Create engaging posts, promotional content, short-form videos, reels, stories, and other social media assets.
 Monitor audience engagement, respond to customer interactions, and encourage community participation.
 Maintain consistent brand identity, messaging, and tone across dealership social media platforms.
 Identify opportunities to capitalize on industry trends, seasonal promotions, motorcycle events, and manufacturer announcements.

3. Video Production & Content Creation



 Conceptualize, write, film, and edit promotional videos and social media content.
 Produce motorcycle and powersports product showcases, walkaround videos, feature highlights, promotional advertisements, and dealership personality content.
 Develop creative concepts and scripts that communicate product features, dealership promotions, and brand messaging.
 Capture photography and video content for inventory, events, marketing campaigns, and promotional materials.
 Coordinate content production with dealership personnel, sales staff, manufacturers, and outside vendors.
 Maintain an organized library of digital marketing assets and creative materials.

4. Promotional Campaigns & Inventory Marketing



 Develop promotional strategies to increase visibility and sales opportunities for new and used inventory.
 Identify aging inventory and coordinate targeted marketing campaigns and promotional opportunities.

directorofcommunicationsmarketinghawaiia.title: Director of Communications & Marketing
directorofcommunicationsmarketinghawaiia.description:
Location: Remote (with periodic travel)


  Employment Type: Full-time, salaried, exempt


  Schedule: 32-hour work week, 4-day full-time position


  Pay Range: $85,000-$90,000/annually


 
 About Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA)
 

  Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to building the capacity of low- and moderate-income communities to achieve and sustain economic self-sufficiency, with a particular focus on Native Hawaiians. Through housing counseling, financial education, lending partnerships, housing initiatives, and innovative programming, HCA works to create long-term pathways toward economic resilience and housing stability across Hawaiʻi. As a Native Hawaiian-focused organization, HCA values adaptability, innovation, cultural grounding, collaboration, and commitment to community. We operate in an evolving environment requiring both mission alignment and the ability to build systems that support organizational growth. 
 

 
Position Summary

 

 The Director of Communications & Marketing is responsible for the planning, execution, coordination, and performance of all marketing and communications activities across Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA). This role is responsible for developing marketing strategy and systems, launching and managing campaigns, generating qualified leads, supporting revenue goals, and translating the CEO’s narrative and organizational priorities into clear, culturally grounded, public-facing communications.


 

   This is not a passive support role. The Director is expected to lead the marketing and communications function as an accountable operating system across HCA’s major organizational pillars: Programs, Ua Hale Aʻela, Real Estate Brokerage, Fund Development, and Awareness/Education campaigns.


   The Director owns marketing strategy, planning, campaign execution, brand consistency, content delivery, and performance tracking within CEO-aligned direction. The role requires proactive planning, cross-team coordination, vendor management, data-informed decision-making, and clear accountability for measurable outcomes.





 Scope of Responsibility: Core Organizational Pillars


 The Director is responsible for ensuring communications and marketing work is actively planned, balanced, and executed across the following pillars. No pillar should be neglected or overprioritized without leadership alignment.





 1. Programs: HUD-Certified Counseling & Financial Education


 
  Drive awareness, trust, and enrollment in HCA’s HUD-certified housing counseling, financial education, and financial capability programs.
  Position financial education and counseling as the backbone of HCA’s housing and economic self-sufficiency model.
  Communicate clear client wins, measurable outcomes, and service pathways so families understand why and how to engage.
  Ensure messaging is culturally grounded, accessible, and prioritized toward Native Hawaiian communities while remaining inclusive of low- and moderate-income households statewide.
 
 2. Ua Hale Aʻela: Real Estate Development, Rent-to-Own, and Available Units


 
  Lead marketing strategy and campaign execution for Ua Hale Aʻela units and program pipeline.
  Generate qualified applicants for each available unit and ensure marketing reaches the right households, not just the largest audience.
  Coordinate with real estate and program teams so marketing launches align with unit readiness, occupancy goals, application timelines, and client qualification requirements.
  Track inquiry volume, qualification rates, lead sources, and cost efficiency for each unit or campaign.
 
 3. Real Estate Brokerage: Mission-Driven Real Estate Services


 
  Build market awareness and trust for HCA’s real estate brokerage as a mission-driven option for buyers, sellers, nonprofit partners, and property management clients.
  Position the brokerage as a way for local residents, mission-aligned sellers, nonprofits, and out-of-state investors to support affordable housing and help Hawaiʻi’s people connect to homes.
  Generate inquiries for buyers, sellers, property management clients, nonprofit partners, and mission-aligned real estate opportunities.
  Support Year 1 brokerage awareness while building the foundation for future transaction and revenue growth.
 
 4. Fund Development: Campaigns, Donor Engagement, and Mission-Aligned Partnerships


 
  Lead the marketing strategy that supports fundraising, donor engagement, campaign visibility, and partner communication.
  Work with the development/fundraising team to create marketing strategies that align with fund development priorities and help deliver campaign goals.
  Contribute measurable revenue or pipeline influence through campaign messaging, donor-facing materials, digital outreach, annual report use, storytelling, and audience engagement.
  Support the $25M campaign and other funding efforts through clear, compelling, and consistent marketing that moves audiences toward action.
 
 5. Awareness, Education & Public Engagement: Cross-Cutting Mission Campaigns


 
  Launch quarterly awareness and education campaigns aligned with HCA’s mission and community needs.
  Use program data, client outcomes, and accessible storytelling to position HCA as a trusted source of education and public awareness.
 
 Role Authority and Alignment


 
  The CEO sets the high-level organizational narrative, vision, and strategic priorities. The Chief Strategy Officer provides executive strategic leadership and oversight for communications and marketing as part of broader organizational strategy, positioning, revenue, and growth priorities. The Senior Director of Strategic Operations, under the direction of the Chief Strategy Officer, provides operational oversight, coordination, and accountability support for communications and marketing systems, workflows, execution, and cross-department alignment.
  The Director is responsible for developing, translating, operationalizing, and delivering marketing and communications strategies aligned to CEO direction, Chief Strategy Officer priorities, and organizational goals.
  The Director may shape external positioning, messaging frameworks, and campaign strategies, but those efforts must remain aligned with CEO direction, executive leadership priorities, and organizational objectives.

Working closely with our U.S. marketing team, global marketing colleagues, external marketing agencies, and sales organization, you'll help keep campaigns organized, moving forward, and aligned with business objectives.

Our marketing programs include digital demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), content marketing, and industry events. Maintain campaign calendars, project trackers, and status reports.Coordinate the collection of campaign performance metrics from agencies and internal teams.Assist with reporting on campaign engagement, lead generation, conversions, and pipeline contribution.Identify opportunities to improve campaign coordination and execution processes.


What We're Looking For




Required Qualifications

2–4 years of B2B marketing experience, preferably in a SaaS or enterprise technology company.Experience coordinating marketing campaigns, projects, or programs involving multiple stakeholders.Familiarity with B2B digital marketing, demand generation, and lead-generation concepts.Strong organizational and project management skills, with excellent attention to detail.Experience collaborating with external agencies, internal creative teams, or cross-functional marketing groups.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to take ownership of assigned projects.Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.Based in either Atlanta, GA or Scottsdale, AZ, with a hybrid work arrangement.

Why Join SEEBURGER?

Be part of a global technology company expanding its investment in U.S. marketing.Gain exposure to integrated demand-generation, ABM, digital marketing, and event programs.Collaborate with experienced marketing professionals, external agencies, and global teams.Contribute to marketing initiatives designed to support measurable business growth.Build your career in B2B technology marketing while taking on meaningful responsibilities.

Company Overview

Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With tens of millions of customers worldwide using products such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

Job Overview

As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit''s commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.

ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms - they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work - and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue - you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner - defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments.

Responsibilities

ERP analyst relationships

Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit''s mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending - keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit''s mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.Digital marketing agency relationships

Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs - prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.Enable agency partners on Intuit''s mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria - ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.Portfolio management & reporting

Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans - additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations - buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends - to the IES product and go-to-market teams.Cross-functional collaboration

Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit''s position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit''s product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations.Qualifications

Required

10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community - you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms.Preferred

Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators - you have existing relationships in this community.Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. The Sr. Branding and Marketing Manager position supports the development and execution of enterprise brand and integrated marketing strategy, helping translate strategic direction into compelling campaigns, content, digital experiences, and market-facing activation. This position will support broader brand and marketing strategy while independently leading defined campaigns, initiatives, and workstreams from strategy through execution. 

This role sits at the intersection of brand, campaigns, content, digital, and creative strategy. The ideal candidate can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on marketing-taking direction and turning it into actionable plans while also identifying opportunities, developing recommendations, and leading work forward. 

The Sr. Branding and Marketing Manager position will develop campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, audience strategies, competitive insights, and recommendations that inform marketing and creative direction. Partner with web and digital teams to connect campaign strategy to digital experiences, customer journeys. Monitor market trends, competitors, and campaign performance to identify opportunities and recommend improvements to strategy and execution.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

- Develop innovative strategies and approaches to increase consumer awareness, understanding and engagement in government programs (e.g. Health Insurance, Child Support, Employment, Education).

- Lead the planning and implementation of integrated communications strategies/tactics across multiple platforms, including print, digital, and social media.

- Work hand-in-hand with MAXIMUS Project Teams and key stakeholders to develop, manage and deliver communication products and services.

- Support business development initiatives and high level meetings with existing and potential future clients.

- Develop briefs and/or presentations in support of new business opportunities.

- Project Management.

- Ensure sound management of client delivery: scope, approaches, timelines, budgets, resources and quality.

- Manage profit and loss (P&L) for assigned accounts, markets or territories.

- Manage resources including direct staff, consultants, vendors and/or subcontractors.

Job Specific requirements:

- 5-7 years of experience in brand strategy, integrated marketing, campaign strategy, content marketing, or related disciplines.

- Experience developing and executing integrated B2B or B2G marketing campaigns.

- Strong understanding of brand positioning, storytelling, audience strategy, content, digital marketing, and campaign development.

- Demonstrated ability to independently lead projects and campaigns while working within a broader marketing strategy.

- Ability to translate complex technology, business, or mission concepts into clear, compelling marketing narratives.

- Strong strategic writing, presentation, and communication skills.

- Ability to collaborate across creative, digital, content, social, communications, events, media, and business teams.

- Proficient with Salesforce, HubSpot or other CRM tools and analytics including AI automation platforms.

- Bachelor's degree in related field required.

Annual salary is just one component of Maximus's total compensation package. Other rewards may include short- and long-term incentives as well as program-specific awards. Additionally, Maximus provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Department: Corporate Partnerships – Partnership Marketing
