Location: Arizona Cardinals (Tempe, AZ) NOTE: Starting 2028, this role will be based at the new Arizona Cardinals Training Facility in north Phoenix, AZ.


Format: In-person


Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a student or employment Visas (including, but not limited to F-1, M-1, J-1, H-1B, OPT and/or CPT programs, etc.).


 


Cardinals Organizational Summary:   


The Arizona Cardinals Football Club is a professional football team within the National Football League (NFL). We compete in the National Football Conference (NFC) West division and call State Farm Stadium, in Glendale, Arizona, our home.


As one of the oldest pro football franchises in the U.S., the Club has established itself as a sport and cultural hallmark within Arizona, as well as a trailblazer for diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) initiatives and firsts around the League.  Our vision is to build a leading sports organization that competes for championships, drives business results, creates loyal fans, develops proud employees, and inspires hope in our community. We are relentless in our pursuit of greatness on and off the field, while positively impacting our people, our fans, and our community.


If you want to join an organization that values putting the team first, doing what is right, growing with positivity, valuing every voice, while driving performance, we would love for you to join our team. Learn more about the Arizona Cardinals and see what’s happening  . 


 


Summary:  


The Senior Manager, Partnership Marketing is responsible for execution and fulfillment of the Club’s corporate partnerships, consisting of Club trademark and promotional rights, stadium signage, media (broadcast, social & digital), consumer promotions, stadium promotions, special events, community relations programs, hospitality, and cause marketing initiatives, all with a with a focus on delivering measurable return on investment for each assigned corporate partner relationship. Create upsell opportunities for corporate partners and focused on the retention and renewal of existing Club partnerships.


 


Primary Job Duties:


The Senior Manager, Partnership Marketing role will have daily responsibilities including, without limitation, to include the following: 



Lead the strategic execution, activation, and overall management of the Club’s corporate partnership portfolio, ensuring best-in-class service, innovation, and delivery against partner objectives
Serve as a senior relationship manager and trusted advisor to corporate partners by developing a deep understanding of each partner’s business priorities, marketing initiatives, and long-term objectives to identify opportunities that maximize value and impact
Drive partnership growth through proactive account management, including renewal strategy development, upsell opportunities, and identification of new revenue-generating initiatives across Club assets and platforms
Oversee the planning and execution of high-profile Club initiatives, tentpole events, and special projects while collaborating cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to support broader organizational goals and strategic priorities of the Arizona Cardinals
Partner closely with departments including marketing, content, entertainment, community relations, foundation, ticketing, finance, and operations to develop and implement integrated partner activations, promotions, community programs, and experiential initiatives that deliver measurable return on investment
Lead the development and presentation of comprehensive partnership recap and ROI reports, providing detailed proof-of-performance analysis, strategic insights, and recommendations to enhance partner value and retention
Manage and oversee all aspects of partnership fulfillment and execution, ensuring contractual obligations are delivered accurately, efficiently, and at the highest standard
Maintain accountability for sponsorship CRM systems, inventory tracking, asset management, and internal reporting processes to ensure operational excellence and organizational alignment
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective corporate partners, representing the organization with professionalism and a high level of strategic business acumen
Collaborate closely with Corporate Partnership Sales and Partnership Solutions teams to support integrated partnership strategies, new business opportunities, and long-term client success
Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development support to Partnership Marketing team members, fostering a collaborative, high-performing, and growth-oriented culture
Contribute to department-wide strategic planning, process improvement initiatives, and overall business operations to help elevate the effectiveness and scalability of the partnership marketing function
Other duties as assigned 

 


Qualifications/Requirements:



Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited 4-year college or university or equivalent experience in marketing, management, or communications
Experience: At least six (6) years of client account management or sponsorship experience
Skills in client service or account management with an emphasis in professional sports team or with a sports and entertainment marketing agency
Strong understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Power Point, Word, and CRM
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong understanding of client service, marketing and sports and event sponsorship programs
Strong time management and organizational skills
Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Demonstrate flexibility and creative problem-solving skills
Ability to develop outstanding internal and external business relationships
Proactive problem solver, possessing a strong work ethic
Good attitude and a commitment to teamwork
Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays; hours will vary depending on business needs
Must complete all pre-employment forms and successfully pass a background check

eventsmarketingcoordinatorarriviainc.title: Events & Marketing Coordinator
eventsmarketingcoordinatorarriviainc.description:
We’re looking for an organized, proactive Events & Marketing Coordinator to bring consumer travel events to life and support the marketing that keeps customers connected. If you enjoy coordinating people, managing details, and seeing a plan come together onsite, this role offers hands-on ownership with room to grow.


 This is an onsite position based in Tucson, Arizona, with local travel required for events.


  About the Role


 Events are the primary focus, from a large annual travel show to smaller supplier presentations and online webinars. You will coordinate free, consumer-facing events that bring multiple travel suppliers together, managing the details from planning and promotion through setup, execution, and follow-up.


 Between seasonal event peaks, you will support marketing campaigns and social media activity. This combined role is ideal for someone with practical event coordination experience or an early-career candidate who has managed meaningful events through internships, hospitality, campus organizations, or community activities.


  What You’ll Own


 
  Event Planning: Coordinate consumer travel shows, supplier presentations, and smaller events, keeping timelines, task lists, and communications organized.
  Supplier and Venue Coordination: Work with travel suppliers, venues, vendors, and internal teams to bring multiple participants together for a well-run event.
  Onsite Execution: Handle setup, registration, signage, materials, onsite coordination, and breakdown, helping guests and suppliers have a positive experience.
  Supplier Webinars: Coordinate online events, including scheduling, promotional materials, participant communications, and follow-up.
  Event Promotion: Support invitations, email communications, and promotional content that encourage attendance at our free events.
  Results and Follow-Up: Track attendance, expenses, and event outcomes, and keep post-event communications and next steps moving.
  Marketing Support: Help coordinate campaigns, creative assets, approvals, and deadlines across email, web, print, and other channels.
  Social Media: Create and schedule event-related and brand content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and monitor engagement.
  Quality and Organization: Proofread materials, check details, and maintain calendars so marketing work and event deadlines stay on track.
 
 What You’ll Bring


 
  Event planning or coordination experience, whether gained professionally, through internships, or through substantial campus or community involvement.
  Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage several deadlines and changing priorities.
  Clear, professional communication with suppliers, vendors, customers, and colleagues.
  A dependable, hands-on approach. You are comfortable handling both the planning and the practical work that makes an event successful.
  Some familiarity with marketing and social media. Broader campaign experience is a plus, but event coordination is the priority.
  Attention to detail and confidence proofreading customer-facing materials.
  Comfort using everyday business software and learning new marketing, webinar, and social media tools.
  Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, Hospitality, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  Reliable transportation for local event travel, including Tucson, Green Valley, Oro Valley, and occasional Phoenix-area events.
  Availability to occasionally work outside standard business hours for events.
  Ability to lift, carry, or move event materials and boxes weighing up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
 
 Who We Are


  arrivia powers travel loyalty and rewards programs for some of the world’s leading brands. We connect travelers with memorable experiences through the technology, supplier relationships, and service that support our partners.


 Bon Voyage Travel is proud to be part of the arrivia family of brands. Together, we connect travelers with exceptional vacation experiences, including cruises, resorts, and tour packages.


  Our Core Values


 
  Stay Curious: Explore new challenges and make space to learn, grow, and improve.
  Keep it Real: Earn trust through open, honest, and clear communication.
  Own it: Seek ways to make an impact and take action.
  Win Together: Create a culture of connection and inclusion where everyone can be their best.
 
 If you’re ready to take ownership of events and contribute to a collaborative marketing team, we’d love to hear from you.

Development & Communications Coordinator

 The Picture House Regional Film Center

 Part-Time | Approximately 25 Hours per Week | Hybrid 




Position Overview 

The Picture House Regional Film Center is seeking an organized, creative, and detail-oriented Development & Communications Coordinator to support our fundraising and communications efforts. Working closely with the Director of Development and Director of Communications, this position is ideal for an enthusiastic self-starter who takes initiative, works independently, and enjoys being part of a fun, fast-paced, and collaborative team. We welcome recent graduates, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates with transferable professional experience. 




Key Responsibilities 

Development & Fundraising 

Work with the Director to support all aspects of nonprofit Development including fundraising campaigns, annual appeals, donor engagement initiatives, membership data, and special events. Maintain donor and membership records, including data entry, gift processing, and database management. Assist with fundraising reports, data analysis, and tracking campaign performance. Prepare donor acknowledgments, correspondence, and fundraising materials. Assist with donor stewardship, special event coordination, and project timelines. Communications & Marketing Work with the Director of Communications to execute marketing and communications initiatives. Implement the social media plan, including scheduling, posting, and monitoring content. Create and coordinate social media content, including posts, reels, stories, and promotional graphics. Maintain the communications calendar and support promotion of films, events, and educational programs. Assist with email newsletters, digital marketing campaigns, and other communications. 


Qualifications & Skills 

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills. Self-starter who takes initiative, works independently, and manages competing priorities. Positive, flexible, team-oriented attitude and willingness to pitch in. Comfortable with spreadsheets, databases, social media, and digital tools. Experience with Canva, email marketing, and/or donor management software a plus. Work Environment & Schedule Approximately 25 hours per week with a hybrid schedule. In-person responsibilities at our Pelham and Bronxville locations. Ability to work remotely, via zoom and phone. Fun, creative, fast-paced, and team-focused nonprofit environment. Occasional evening and weekend commitments for special events and programs. About The Picture House The Picture House Regional Film Center, Inc. is a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization bringing people together through film, education, and cultural programming. With historic theaters in Pelham and Bronxville, we offer films, special events, and educational experiences that inspire and connect our communities.

directorofproductmanagementtacticalcommu.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications - on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.

Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of "Keeping Our Heroes Connected"?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Director of Product Management - Tactical Communications & Integrated Solutions who will report to the Director of Product Management on the Product team. The successful individual in this role will own the business performance, multi-year product strategy, gross margins, and full lifecycle execution across our core StreamCaster radio hardware, embedded OEM modules, turnkey Integrated Solutions, ecosystem accessories, and StreamCare+ service monetization models.

This position is located at Silvus Technologies' Engineering and R&D Office in Irvine, CA, near the vibrant Irvine Spectrum and is on a hybrid schedule: onsite Monday through Thursday, at our Irvine office, and Fridays are remote/work-from-home. Visits may be needed to Los Angeles HQ as needed to collaborate with the broader Engineering team and other teams.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location for candidates based in the US, with a willingness to travel up to 25-50% of the time to maintain customer engagement, support field testing, and visit OEM/defense partners and/or Los Angeles HQ.

This role owns the strategic "What & Why" (business view) and leads a team of Technical Product Managers (TPMs) who drive the technical "How & When" (execution view) across three core product pillars:

Radio Platforms & Embedded Modules: StreamCaster radios, OEM modules, mission modules, and future tactical communications hardware platforms.Integrated Solutions: Productized, mission-ready solutions combining Silvus radios, networking capabilities, software, accessories, and partner technologies.Product Ecosystem & Services: Accessories, peripherals, support offerings, warranties, and lifecycle services that extend the value of Silvus products.The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Line Strategy & 2-to-3 Year Roadmap

Tactical Communications Market Strategy: Own market strategy, physical lifecycle, SKU tier optimization, feature tiering, and End-of-Life (EOL) strategies across physical radio chassis, OEM board-level modules, mission modules, turnkey systems, and accessories.Integrated Solutions Strategy: Identify recurring mission needs that can be addressed through repeatable, productized solutions combining Silvus radios, software, accessories, and partner technologies. Establish the strategy for converting successful customer-specific integrations into scalable portfolio offerings.Multi-Year Roadmap Ownership: Direct and maintain the 3-to-5 year radio hardware roadmap, as well as the 2-to-3 year embedded module and Integrated Solutions roadmaps, aligning long-term product strategy with upcoming market requirements.New Market Expansion: Identify and evaluate adjacent markets where Silvus' core communications technologies can create differentiated value and develop the product and commercialization strategy required to enter attractive segments.Requirements & Concept Definition: Synthesize defense industry trends, emerging threats, and warfighter feedback into high-impact Market Requirements Documents (MRDs) and product charters.Certifications: Identify and drive appropriate domestic and global certifications for tactical communications and integrated solutions.Portfolio Investment Prioritization: Evaluate competing market opportunities, customer requirements, technology investments, and internal R&D initiatives. Recommend investment priorities based on strategic fit, market potential, competitive differentiation, platform leverage, engineering capacity, and expected return.Business Performance, P&L & Business Case Execution

Business Performance: Own the business plan and performance of the Tactical Communications portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, adoption, competitive position, and lifecycle performance. Partner with Finance, Sales, Engineering, and Operations to identify and execute corrective actions when portfolio performance deviates from plan.Margin Performance & Cost Targets: Drive overall product profitability by setting and optimizing target Bill of Materials (BOM) costs, pricing structures, and evaluating cost-performance trade-offs across radio, OEM module, mission modules, and integrated system segments.Business Case Modeling: Define and structure rigorous business cases (including 3-to-5 year hardware sales projections, ROI analyses, and CapEx/OpEx justifications) for all major new radio platforms, embedded modules, mission modules and integrated solution launches.Lifecycle & Services Strategy: Define service, warranty, sustainment, upgrade, and support offerings that increase customer value, improve lifecycle economics, and create recurring revenue opportunities across the installed base.Post-Launch Performance Governance: Measure and track post-launch portfolio performance relative to the approved business plan, executing continuous updates or lifecycle optimizations as needed.Market Positioning, Competitive Intelligence & Go-To-Market Leadership

Go-To-Market & Commercial Readiness: Direct Go-To-Market strategies for your reporting TPM teams. Oversee promotional strategies, product packaging, and sales enablement methods designed to accelerate adoption and drive sales growth.Portfolio Positioning: Drive hardware and integrated solution positioning strategies to capture market share from legacy defense primes and out-innovate emerging tactical wireless competitors.Competitive Intelligence: Develop and maintain a comprehensive competitive landscape detailing competitor hardware specs, SWaP-C metrics, turnkey capabilities, pricing, and accessory ecosystems.Customer & Program Office Engagement: Partner directly with DoD program offices, prime integrators, and key commercial accounts to translate tactical field needs into product requirements.People Leadership & TPM Mentorship

Lead & Mentor team of TPMs: Provide strategic direction, prioritization guidelines, and coaching to dedicated Technical Product Managers (TPMs) executing across tactical comms NPI, integrated solutions NPI, ecosystem offerings, Jira backlogs, and engineering cadences.Requirements & Backlog Alignment: Translate customer insights into structured Market Requirements Documents (MRDs) and work with TPMs to ensure engineering priorities align with business strategy.Portfolio-to-Product Translation: Partner with Product Managers to translate portfolio strategy and market requirements into clearly defined product initiatives, ensuring individual product development efforts remain aligned with the broader tactical communications, integrated solutions, and ecosystem strategy.Concept to Commercialization: Drive hardware, accessories, and services products from prototype and concept stages into scalable, sellable, and operationally viable solutions.Travel Requirements - Ability to travel 25-50% of the time to maintain customer engagement, support field testing, and visit OEM/defense partners.Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field.Minimum of 13 years of professional experience, including 5+ years of progressive product management experience in tactical radio communications, defense electronics, RF hardware, or wireless networking.Demonstrated experience building 3-to-5 year hardware business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, setting target BOM costs, and driving gross margin optimization.Proven experience managing, leading, or mentoring technical professionals (TPMs, Systems Engineers, or Technical Marketing Engineers).Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.Must be a U.S. Citizen due to clients under U.S. government contracts.All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or an MBA.Strong knowledge of tactical radio architectures, SWaP constraints, embedded OEM modules, turnkey integrated systems (C2/ISR), and military communications requirements.Direct experience with unmanned systems integration (Group 1-3 UAS, UGV, USV) and drone OEM markets.Familiarity with hardware phase-gate NPI processes, MIL-STD testing, and manufacturing supply chain scaling.WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment.Trade shows.Outdoor environment for demonstrations.Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.Walking/Moving in the labs.COMPENSATION: $220,000 - $265,000 / annually

communicationsspecialiststateofmarylandl.description:
Introduction

The MD Labor Division of Workforce Development and Adult Learning (DWDAL) operates a statewide network of workforce programs and partnerships through its six program offices, which administer workforce development, registered apprenticeship, adult education, correctional education, strategic workforce initiatives, and the statewide network of American Job Centers, helping individuals gain the skills needed for successful careers while strengthening Maryland’s economy.


The Communications team leads strategic communications for the division’s workforce development initiatives. The team develops and executes communications strategies, digital content, executive communications, and public outreach initiatives that elevate DWDAL’s programs and connect Marylanders with workforce resources. Working closely with executive leadership and program offices, the team helps ensure clear, consistent, and impactful communications across the division and with agency leadership, external partners, and audiences.


 GRADE

STD0018

 LOCATION OF POSITION

This position is located in downtown Baltimore near the Inner Harbor at 100 S. Charles Street, Baltimore, MD 21201.  This is a hybrid position that requires employees to work both in office and remotely.


 Main Purpose of Job

The Communications Specialist – Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) provides communications, outreach, and public information support for the Division of Workforce Development and Adult Learning's Rural Health Transformation Program and related initiatives administered by the Office of Strategic Initiatives (OSI). The position develops, writes, edits, and coordinates communications materials that promote awareness of RHTP programs, funding opportunities, partnerships, events, outcomes, and workforce initiatives. Responsibilities include drafting press releases, social media content, website content, executive briefing materials, executive speeches, talking points, newsletters, reports, and other communications products; managing and coordinating website content and updates; providing photography and event support; and ensuring materials comply with accessibility requirements and Department standards. Reporting to the Director of Communications, the position works closely with the OSI Deputy Director, RHTP Program Managers, DWDAL leadership, and other internal and external stakeholders to support communications activities that advance the goals and objectives of the Rural Health Transformation Program.


 POSITION DUTIES

Administrative and Communications Coordination



    Provide support for the planning and implementation of Rural Health Transformation Program communications and outreach activities.
    Coordinate communications projects and maintain project schedules, content calendars, and
    communications records.
    Compile, organize, and maintain files, digital assets, photographs, publications, and other communications materials related to RHTP activities.
    Coordinate with internal staff, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to support communications and outreach initiatives.
    Track communications deliverables and maintain records related to communications activities and program milestones.


Communications, Publications, Website and Content Development


    Research, write, edit, design, and publish communications materials including press releases, fact sheets, newsletters, brochures, flyers, reports, announcements, success stories, and promotional materials.
    Develop social media content and digital communications materials to support awareness of Rural Health Transformation Program initiatives and activities.
    Draft website content and prepare materials for posting to the Maryland Department of Labor website and other digital platforms.
    Coordinate website updates by preparing content and submitting work requests to Information Technology staff for webpage updates, modifications, and creation of new webpages.
    Translate complex program, funding, workforce development, and policy information into clear, concise, and audience-appropriate communications.
    Assist with the preparation, production, and publication of communications materials supporting RHTP programs, grants, initiatives, and events.
    Ensure communications products comply with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), ADA Title II requirements, Section 508 requirements, and Department standards.
    Compile and organize success stories, program outcomes, testimonials, and impact narratives for use in communications materials and reports.
    Photograph and document RHTP events, meetings, site visits, and other activities for use in publications, websites, social media, and promotional materials.


Executive Communications and Briefing Support 


    
    Prepare briefing documents, including background information, event details, objectives, key speaker information, and related materials, for the Secretary of Labor, Assistant Secretary, and other executive leadership.
    Draft and edit talking points, key messages, speeches, event remarks, presentations, briefing materials, and other executive communications materials. 
    Research and compile background information regarding events, stakeholders, organizations, and program activities to support executive participation.
    Coordinate with program staff and leadership to ensure communications materials accurately reflect program goals, activities, and outcomes.


Event Support and Agency Representation

    
    Represent the Department and Division at meetings, conferences, webinars, stakeholder events, and other functions as assigned. 
    Provide communications support for RHTP-sponsored events, including event preparation, on-site communications assistance, photography, and post-event communications activities.
    



 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate. 
Experience: Six years of administrative staff or professional work. 
Notes: 
1. Candidates may substitute 30 college credit hours from an accredited college or university for each year up to four years of the required experience. 
2. Candidates may substitute the possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and two years of experience in administrative staff or professional work for the required experience. 
3. Candidates may substitute the possession of a Master's degree from an accredited college or university for the required experience. 
4. Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer involving staff work related to the administration of rules, regulations, policy, procedures and processes, or overseeing or coordinating unit operations or functioning as a staff assistant to a higher ranking commissioned officer on a year-for-year basis for the required experience. 


 DESIRED OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Preference will be given to applicants who possess the following preferred qualification(s). Include clear and specific information on your application regarding your qualifications.

    Four or more years of solid experience with writing communications products, including press releases, speeches, briefing documents, website content, social media content, and newsletters. 
    Four or more years of communications project management experience. 
    Two or more years of designing flyers, reports, and other deliverables. 
    Two or more years of developing materials in compliance with applicable accessibility standards and requirements (e.g., WCAG, ADA, Section 508), and applies accessibility best practices to written, digital, and multimedia content.
    Bachelor's degree in design and/or classes in communications. 
    Experience in photography.
    




If you receive an invitation to interview, you will be required to bring two writing samples with you:



    
    Professional Writing Sample: A writing sample of 500-1,000 words. Acceptable examples include speeches, press releases, news articles, blog posts, or similar professional writing. 
    Social Media Sample: An example of a social media post you have developed for any platform.  The sample must include both the caption and a visual (e.g., graphic, photo, video). Please include a brief description of your goal and strategy for the post. Also describe if the post was successful and how you define that success.




 LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS AND CERTIFICATIONS

Employees in this classification may be assigned duties which require the operation of a motor vehicle. Employees assigned such duties will be required to possess a motor vehicle operator's license valid in the State of Maryland.


 SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

All candidates are subject to a background check against files maintained by the Division of Unemployment Insurance (LABOR/DUI) to determine whether any monies are owed to LABOR/DUI as a result of unemployment overpayment/fraud. Any unpaid debt may have an impact on whether or not a candidate is offered employment.


 SELECTION PROCESS

Applicants who meet the minimum (and selective) qualifications will be included in further evaluation. The evaluation may be a rating of your application based on your education, training and experience as they relate to the requirements of the position. Therefore, it is essential that you provide complete and accurate information in the job duty section on your application. Please report all related education, experience, dates and hours of work. Clearly indicate your college degree and major on your application, if applicable.


For education obtained outside the U.S., any job offer will be contingent on the candidate providing an evaluation for equivalency by a foreign credential evaluation service prior to starting employment (and may be requested prior to interview). Complete applications must be submitted by the closing date. Information submitted after this date will not be added. Incorrect application forms will not be accepted.


Candidates may remain on the certified eligible list for a period of at least one year. The resulting certified eligible list for this recruitment may be used for similar positions in this or other State agencies.


 BENEFITS


Contractual employees who work for an agency covered under the State Employee and Retiree Health and Welfare Benefits Program, have a current employment contract and work 30 or more hours a week (or on average 130 hours per month) may be eligible for subsidized health benefits coverage for themselves and their dependents. As a contractual employee, you will be responsible for paying 25% of the premiums for your medical and prescription coverage, including any eligible dependents you have enrolled. The State of Maryland will subsidize the remaining 75% of the cost for these benefits. You can also elect to enroll in dental coverage, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and life insurance, but will be responsible to pay the full premium for these benefits.
Leave may be granted to a contractual employee at a rate of one hour for every 30 hours worked, not to exceed 40 hours per calendar year.



 FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS


The online application is STRONGLY preferred. However, if you are unable to apply online, or having difficulty with your login or password, please contact DBM's Helpdesk directly at (410) 767-4850 (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM daily, except for holidays and weekends). After business hours, please submit an email request to Application.Help@maryland.gov. If you encounter difficulty attaching required or optional documentation, you may submit via mail to erin.alston1@maryland.gov. Please be sure to include your name, identification number (Easy ID#) and job announcement number on any documentation to ensure timely processing.


We thank our Veterans for their service to our country and encourage them to apply. If you are seeking a veteran's preference, please submit a copy of your DD-214.


The paper application must be received by 5 pm, close of business, on the closing date for the recruitment.  No postmarks will be accepted. Incorrect application forms will not be accepted.


PLEASE DO NOT FAX OR EMAIL UNSOLICITED DOCUMENTATION.


Completed applications, required documentation, and any required addendums may be mailed to:
Maryland Department of Labor/ Office of Administration
Attn: Erin Alston  26-002588-0064
100 S. Charles Street, 5th Floor 
Baltimore, MD 21201


TTY  Users: call via Maryland Relay


For additional information, please contact Erin Alston 410-230-6301 at  or via email erin.altson1@maryland.gov.


The MD State Application Form can be found online.


Maryland Department of Labor is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of LABOR that all persons have equal opportunity and access to employment opportunities, services, and facilities without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, marital status, parental status, sexual orientation, disability or veteran status.

nationalmarketingmanagerkahalamanagement.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
 The National Marketing Manager will support franchisees with regional and local advertising and marketing efforts across more than 160 Designated Market Areas (DMAs) nationwide. This role will also partner with the Vice President of Marketing and Vice President of National Programs to develop integrated campaigns that connect national, regional, and local marketing efforts with brand initiatives, standards, and special projects. This is a full-time, administrative level role, and is not visa eligible.


  KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES


 
  Supports the Vice President of Marketing and fellow National Marketing Managers while overseeing assigned regions, co-ops, and DMAs.
  Collaborates with cross-functional teams to execute strategic national marketing programs and partnerships.
  Develops and maintains project plans, timelines, and performance tracking for regional and brand programs, including coordinating co-op media buys with agency partners.
  Oversees assigned store-level and co-op creative needs, including local store marketing, print, direct mail, outdoor advertising, and digital media.
  Leads grand opening planning and timelines, supporting store and field teams with local execution as needed.
  Partners with field operations teams to identify in-store and community-based opportunities that increase brand awareness and sales while maintaining brand standards.
  Analyzes store-level data to develop local marketing strategies that improve sales and performance.
  Creates communications and rollout materials to keep internal teams and franchisees informed of marketing plans, promotions, campaign results, next steps, and key learnings.
 
  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS
 
  Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  Minimum of 3-5 years related work experience.
  Demonstrates clear and effective professional communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to present ideas and information clearly.
  Strong proficiency in Windows and Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
  Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, prioritization and follow-up skills. Ability to meet tight deadlines with little supervision.
  Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  Customer Service and/or Client Relations experience.
  Prior experience with local and regional marketing support and execution.
  Prior experience in brand management.
 
  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS


 
  Proactive, assertive, and creative approach to problem solving.
  Sound understanding of marketing principles and the creative process, as well as the latest technologies and how to apply them to an overall marketing plan.
  Precision in grammar, spelling and syntax.
  A strategic thinker able to understand big-picture objectives and lay out specific strategies and tactics in the pursuit of common goals.
  Prior experience working within a franchise system or in the restaurant industry.
  Prior experience and knowledge with media planning and buying.
  Ability to analyze and read large amounts of data and extrapolate key learnings.
 
  PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS


 Physical requirements include, but are not limited to, alternating between standing and sitting; working at a desk/looking at a computer screen; driving, and speaking. Graphic Design and Content Development Create engaging and visually compelling content for social media, websites, email campaigns, reports, presentations, outreach materials, and digital campaigns. Photography and Event Documentation Take, select, edit, caption, organize, and archive photographs for organizational communications. Document community events, training sessions, outreach activities, advocacy events, staff gatherings, and other organizational activities. Follow organizational procedures concerning photography permissions, consent, confidentiality, privacy, and respectful representation of community members. Website Management and Maintenance Assist with maintaining NMILC’s Squarespace website, including uploading and formatting content, updating pages, checking links, and making basic layout adjustments. Reporting and Administrative Support Track social media, website, email marketing, and digital campaign performance. Preferred Qualifications The following experience and skills will be considered an advantage: Experience preparing and delivering design files for professional printing, including knowledge of print specifications, file formats, proofing processes, and coordination with printing vendors. Experience supporting nonprofit fundraising and donor communications, including development campaigns, event promotions, annual appeals, donor stewardship materials, and grant-related communications. Familiarity with community-centered storytelling and ethical photography practices, particularly when working with immigrant communities and individuals affected by public policy. Understanding of messaging and strategic communications approaches used in nonprofit organizations and policy advocacy. marketingcoordinatorremotemycomputercare.description:
About TechSkills & MyComputerCareer:  TechSkills is the B2B workforce training division of MyComputerCareer (MyCC), focused on helping organizations and technology professionals build the skills needed to succeed in a rapidly changing digital landscape. Through instructor-led training, digital learning, certification programs, and customized workforce solutions, TechSkills partners with businesses to strengthen capabilities across areas including AI, cloud, cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, and other high-demand technical disciplines. 

 While TechSkills operates as a distinct customer-facing brand, our team members are part of MyComputerCareer and share in the same commitment to  Love, Customer First, Excellence, and Ethics  . At MyCC, we're focused on transforming lives and organizations through technology education and creating meaningful opportunities for the people we serve. 

 Location:  Remote 

 Compensation Range: $60-75K Annually 

 Candidates can reside in one of the following states:  AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, MO, MS, NC, NV, OH, OK, SC, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, and WI. 

 PURPOSE OF POSITION  The Marketing Coordinator plays a key role in building demand, strengthening the TechSkills brand, and supporting pipeline growth across our B2B training business. 

 Working closely with the Director of Marketing and Sales, this role helps execute integrated marketing campaigns across email, social media, webinars, events, and sales enablement channels. The Marketing Coordinator will translate TechSkills' products and solutions into clear, compelling messaging while developing the campaigns and content needed to engage prospects and move opportunities through the sales funnel. 

 This is a hands-on role for a marketer who is equally comfortable developing content, coordinating campaigns, managing webinars and events, analyzing performance, and partnering closely with Sales. 

 ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  Campaign Strategy & Execution 

 Support the development and execution of integrated B2B marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads, increase engagement, and support revenue growth. 

 Build and execute multi-touch email and messaging sequences, including modified Agoge-style outreach and nurture campaigns. 

 Coordinate campaign activities across email, digital, social media, webinars, events, and sales outreach. 

 Partner closely with Sales to align campaign strategy, messaging, lead follow-up, and pipeline objectives. 

 Support lead nurturing and marketing automation workflows that move prospects from initial engagement to sales conversations. 

 Demand Generation & Events 

 Coordinate the development, promotion, execution, and follow-up of TechSkills webinars and virtual events. 

 Support trade shows, conferences, sponsorships, and other demand-generation events. 

 Develop pre-event and post-event campaigns designed to maximize attendance, engagement, lead capture, and follow-up. 

 Partner with internal subject matter experts to develop relevant webinar and event content. 

 Content & Sales Enablement 

 Develop and maintain marketing and sales collateral, including one-pagers, brochures, presentations, case studies, email content, and campaign materials. 

 Translate TechSkills products, services, and technical training solutions into clear and compelling customer-facing messaging. 

 Support Sales with content and tools that strengthen prospect conversations and communicate the TechSkills value proposition. 

 Maintain consistent product and brand messaging across marketing and sales channels. 

 Social Media & Digital Presence 

 Develop and execute social media content across platforms including LinkedIn and YouTube. 

 Create content that builds brand awareness, demonstrates TechSkills expertise, promotes programs and events, and generates engagement. 

 Coordinate content calendars and campaign schedules across digital channels. 

 Support ongoing improvements to TechSkills' digital presence and customer journey. 

 Analytics & Optimization 

 Monitor campaign performance, engagement, lead activity, and conversion metrics. 

 Analyze results to identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, sequencing, and campaign effectiveness. 

 Provide regular reporting on marketing activities and their contribution to lead generation and sales pipeline. 

 Test and refine campaign approaches based on performance data. 

 KEY COMPETENCIES  B2B Marketing:  Understanding of B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, lead nurturing, and sales pipeline development. 

 Campaign Execution:  Ability to coordinate multiple campaign components across email, social, digital, webinars, events, and sales outreach. 

 Content Development:  Strong writing and communication skills with the ability to turn complex products and technical concepts into compelling customer-facing content. 

 Sales Partnership:  Ability to collaborate closely with Sales and understand how marketing activities support pipeline development and revenue goals. 

 Project & Time Management:  Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. 

 Analytical Thinking:  Comfortable reviewing marketing performance data and using insights to improve campaign effectiveness. 

 Initiative:  Self-directed and proactive, with the ability to identify needs, recommend solutions, and move projects forward in a fast-paced environment. 

 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS 2–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, or a related role. 

 Experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns. 

 Experience with email marketing, lead nurturing, marketing automation, and CRM platforms. 

 Demonstrated ability to create professional marketing and sales collateral. 

 Experience coordinating webinars, virtual events, trade shows, or other demand-generation activities. 

 Strong written communication and copywriting skills. 

 Experience using marketing performance data to evaluate and optimize campaigns. 

 Proficiency with CRM and marketing automation platforms; experience with Microsoft Dynamics and Mailjet is a plus. 

 Experience with webinar platforms such as Zoom and social media management tools. 

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  Experience in IT, SaaS, software, technology training, or professional education. 

 Experience marketing B2B workforce development, training, or certification solutions. 

 Familiarity with direct-response marketing and multi-touch prospecting/nurture sequences. 

 Experience supporting sales enablement initiatives. 

 Experience marketing through LinkedIn and YouTube. 

 Basic HTML/CSS knowledge. 

 Familiarity with Microsoft, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, or technology certification markets. 

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE  Success in this role means: 

 Consistent execution of high-quality campaigns that generate engagement and support pipeline growth. 

 Strong alignment between Marketing and Sales. 

 Clear and compelling TechSkills messaging across digital, sales, and customer-facing channels. 

 Well-executed webinars and events that generate qualified opportunities. 

 Effective marketing workflows and nurture campaigns supported by CRM and automation systems. 

 A recognizable and trusted TechSkills brand within the IT training and workforce development market. 

 PHYSICAL AND COGNITIVE DEMANDS  The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

 While performing the duties of this job, the employee may: 

 Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. 

 Frequently operate a computer, phone, and other standard office equipment. 

 Communicate and exchange accurate information with employees, customers, prospects, vendors, and business partners. 

 Occasionally move about office spaces, training venues, conferences, or event locations. 

 Occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds. 

 Maintain the cognitive ability to manage multiple priorities, analyze information, solve problems, and work effectively in an environment with changing priorities and frequent interruptions. 

 The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Employees will follow other instructions and perform other duties as assigned by their manager. 

 WHY JOIN US? Joining the TechSkills team means helping organizations and technology professionals build the capabilities they need for what's next. You'll have the opportunity to help grow a dynamic B2B technology-training brand while being part of the broader MyComputerCareer organization and culture. 

 COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS THAT SUPPORT YOU AT EVERY STAGE  We believe taking care of our people is just as important as taking care of the customers and students we serve. Eligible full-time employees enjoy a well-rounded benefits package designed to support health, financial security, and overall well-being. 

 Our benefits include: 

 Multiple medical plan options, including HSA plans with employer contributions 

 Dental and vision coverage 

 Company-paid life and disability insurance 

401(k) with company match 

 Generous paid time off and holidays 

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for confidential personal support 

 Optional coverage such as accident, critical illness, and pet insurance 

 We're committed to helping our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain balance both at work and at home. 

 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY  We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

ehssmanagergloballearningcommunicationsa.title: EHS&S Manager, Global Learning & Communications
ehssmanagergloballearningcommunicationsa.description:
The Manager, Global Learning & Communications is responsible for leading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise-wide Environmental, Health, Safety & Sustainability (EHS&S) learning, communications, engagement, and capability-building strategies. This role drives organizational effectiveness by establishing global learning frameworks, leadership development programs, employee engagement initiatives, and communication strategies that strengthen EHS&S performance and culture across the organization. This role serves as a strategic EHS&S leadership position responsible for advancing EHS&S outcomes through learning, communications, competency development, and culture transformation initiatives that directly impact safety, environmental stewardship, health, sustainability performance, regulatory compliance, risk reduction, and operational excellence. Success in this role requires deep EHS&S functional expertise to develop and execute programs that strengthen organizational capability and support the long-term EHS&S strategic agenda across the enterprise. Working closely with business leaders, Human Resources, Operations, Corporate Communications, and regional EHS&S teams, the incumbent develops scalable global programs that enhance employee competency, leadership accountability, organizational learning, and workforce engagement. The position plays a critical role in fostering a culture where EHS&S excellence is integrated into daily operations and business decision-making worldwide.

MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (List in order of importance)Global Learning Strategy & Capability Development  Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the global EHS&S learning and development strategy. Establish enterprise-wide competency models, capability frameworks, and role-based learning requirements. Design and maintain structured curricula to support technical, professional, and leadership development needs. Ensure learning programs align with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and operational priorities. Drive continuous learning initiatives that improve workforce capability and business performance. Leadership Development Programs  Design, implement, and evaluate leadership development programs that strengthen EHS&S leadership capability. Partner with business leaders and HR to identify leadership skill gaps and succession development needs. Facilitate leadership workshops, training sessions, and development activities that build accountability and engagement. Promote leadership behaviors that reinforce EHS&S excellence and organizational values. Communications Strategy & Employee Engagement  Develop and execute comprehensive global EHS&S communication strategies. Lead awareness campaigns that reinforce organizational priorities, performance expectations, and key initiatives. Create communication standards and governance practices that ensure consistency of messaging across regions and business units. Enhance employee engagement through targeted communication programs, recognition initiatives, and culture-building activities. Support executive communications related to EHS&S strategy, performance, accomplishments, and organizational goals. Culture Transformation & Organizational Effectiveness  Develop methodologies and assessment tools to measure EHS&S culture maturity and organizational effectiveness. Lead initiatives that promote cultural transformation, employee accountability, and continuous improvement. Analyze engagement, culture, and behavioral data to identify improvement opportunities. Recommend and implement actions that strengthen organizational culture and employee commitment. Knowledge Management & Organizational Learning  Establish systems and processes that facilitate knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and best-practice dissemination. Support enterprise-wide organizational learning initiatives through collaboration platforms and communication channels. Ensure critical knowledge and capabilities are captured and shared across global operations. Promote innovation and continuous improvement through learning communities and collaborative networks. Stakeholder Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration  Collaborate closely with HR, Operations, Communications, and EHS&S leaders to integrate EHS&S competencies and capability requirements into talent management processes, while maintaining ownership and accountability for EHS&S learning, communications, engagement, and competency programs within the EHS&S function. HR serves as a key stakeholder and enabling partner in support of EHS&S business objectives. Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders regarding learning effectiveness, culture development, and communication initiatives. Build strong partnerships with regional and global stakeholders to ensure successful program implementation and adoption. Lead cross-functional project teams and enterprise initiatives as assigned. Program Governance, Measurement & Continuous Improvement  Establish performance metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to evaluate learning, engagement, and communication effectiveness. Monitor program outcomes using analytics, participant feedback, and business performance indicators. Develop recommendations for continuous improvement based on data-driven insights. Manage project timelines, resources, budgets, and implementation plans to achieve organizational objectives. QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience And/or Certifications)Education / Training  Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development, Human Resources, Communications, Business Administration, Education, Learning & Development, or a related field required. Master's degree in Organizational Development, Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Education, or related discipline preferred. Experience  Minimum of 8-12 years of progressive experience in learning and development, organizational development, communications, change management, EHS&S, or related professional disciplines. Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing enterprise-wide or multi-site programs. Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating large-scale learning and development programs. Experience leading employee engagement, culture transformation, or organizational communication initiatives. Experience influencing senior leaders and managing stakeholder relationships across multiple functions and geographic regions. Experience supporting global organizations preferred. Experience within manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceutical, chemical, industrial, or similarly regulated environments preferred. Preferred  Certified Professional in Learning and Performance (CPLP) or equivalent ATD certification Prosci Change Management Certification Lean Certification Six Sigma Certification Other organizational development, training, communications, or project management credentials KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)Knowledge  Organizational learning and development principles. Adult learning theory and instructional design methodologies. Leadership development frameworks. Change management methodologies and organizational effectiveness practices. Strategic communications and employee engagement principles. EHS&S concepts and organizational culture development. Talent development and competency management processes. Performance measurement and learning analytics. Strong knowledge of EHS&S regulations, compliance requirements, risk management principles, operational processes, and competency-based performance improvement methodologies. Skills  Strategic planning and execution. Facilitation and presentation skills. Executive-level written and verbal communication. Curriculum and program design. Stakeholder management and relationship building. Project and program management. Data analysis and reporting. Communication campaign development. Training needs assessment and gap analysis. Learning Management System (LMS) administration and digital learning technologies. Abilities  Ability to influence and gain commitment from senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups. Ability to lead complex global initiatives across multiple functions and regions. Ability to translate strategic objectives into practical learning and communication solutions. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to analyze data and develop actionable recommendations.

At AutoNation, we're transforming the automotive retail experience through innovative marketing, data-driven strategy, and strong partnerships with our dealership teams. We're looking for an Automotive Field Marketing Manager to serve as the primary marketing partner for a portfolio of dealerships, helping drive vehicle sales, service revenue, customer acquisition, and brand growth across local markets.

Required Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Why Join AutoNation?

ㅤ



Exciting Benefits and Perks Await You:Competitive compensation and 401k matching

Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with insurance plans (health, dental, vision) and maternity benefits.

Associate purchase and discount programs for new and pre-owned vehicles, services, parts, collision, accessories, and AutoGear

Access amazing deals and discounts through YouDecide, a website with offers from top providers and retailers

Join our DRVPNK mission to raise and donate millions of dollars to cancer research and treatment, partnering with cancer charities nationwide





AutoNation is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offering innovative products, exceptional services, and comprehensive solutions, empowering our customers to make the best decisions for their needs. With a network of dealerships nationwide strengthened by a recognized brand, we offer a wide variety of new and used vehicles, customer financing, parts, and provide expert maintenance and repair services. Through DRV PNK, we have raised over $40 million for cancer-related causes, demonstrating our commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of our Associates, Customers, and the communities we serve.
 

AutoNation is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment in our workplace and the services we provide. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who are passionate about making a positive impact. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Join our team and help us foster a culture of belonging while contributing to our revolutionary work in the automotive industry. We value innovation, teamwork, and a commitment to making a positive impact in the world.

  Position Summary
 The Manager Emergency & Crisis Response Communications reports to the Director of Communications of Generation and Emergency Response, with responsibility for creating tools, processes, and strategies to facilitate generation emergency communications and issue management across the enterprise.


 

   This role requires extensive experience in communications, demands attention to detail and demonstrated ability to collaborate within a matrixed organization to formulate emergency response communication strategies and messaging. The position also involves executing complex emergency response and issue-specific drills throughout the enterprise.


 

   As part of the Corporate Affairs team, this role is responsible for cultivating constructive relationships with external stakeholders, such as state and county officials, local emergency response organizations, and industry partners. The position requires the capacity to operate both independently and collaboratively within a team setting, engage directly with senior leadership, collaborating with executive leaders on communications as appropriate, and effectively managing high-pressure situations while adapting promptly to shifting priorities.


 

    Responsibilities
 
  Serves as part of the company’s crisis communications team, assessing and mitigating risks that may impact the company’s reputation.
  Participates in on-call emergency duty rotation.
  Works with internal clients to conceptualize emergency preparedness strategies and develops support materials to facilitate potential response.
  Maintains the Corporate JIC and associated processes, procedures and materials associated with emergency response, in a state of readiness.
  Organizes and supports media staging areas, including field locations and alternative media centers as required, through collaboration with Corp. Comm. leadership and company operational personnel.
  Facilitates comprehensive emergency planning across the enterprise, manages logistics for drills and tabletop exercises, identifies gaps and opportunities for enhancement, and coordinates action plans to ensure ongoing improvement.
  Coordinates training for emergency response rolls within Corporate Affairs, including annual assessment of roles and responsibilities, and updating training materials in coordination with Corporate Communication leadership and business unit leaders.
  Fosters relationships with State and County emergency management teams and emergency response organizations in jurisdictions Duke Energy serves; serving on emergency planning task forces and committees to support collaboration with community stakeholders.
  Works in collaboration with other Corporate Communication SMEs to identify emerging issues and develop communications plans to address issues and avoid potential adverse impacts to the company.
  Conducts benchmark studies with industry peers to assess opportunities for enhancing the company’s emergency response strategies and implements improvement plans as needed.
  Manages emergency preparedness information and messaging for internal and external use on shared platforms, including the Web, Portal, and dark sites.
  Collaborates with subject matter experts within Corporate Communications on media inquiries related to emergency response and issues management.
 
 

    Basic/Required Qualifications


 
  Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, or a related field (such as marketing or public relations)
  Minimum six (6) years of experience in communications, public affairs, journalism, emergency planning, or a related field.
 
 

    Desired Qualifications
 
  8-10 years of experience in corporate communications
  Experience in creating complex strategic communications plans designed to help leaders and clients achieve their business objectives
  Executive communications support within a matrix organization
  Experience in providing strategic counsel to executives and business unit leaders
  Excellent relationship management skills and ability to manage/integrate with multiple stakeholders inside and outside of the company
  Highly flexible, adaptable and detail oriented.
  Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and prioritize tasks
  Excellent collaboration skills
  Strong written and verbal communication skills
  Knowledge of emergency management principles and practices
  Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills
  Experience in electric utility industry or other highly regulated, high-profile industry
  Experience in leading complex, high-profile communications projects

   Hybrid Mobility Classification – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, hybrid employees must live within a reasonable commute to their designated Duke Energy facility, not greater than 50 miles one way. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.



The PositionThe Brand & Creative Management Subchapter within the Global Solutions Marketing Chapter is dedicated to delivering a cohesive, positive, and consistent brand experience for customers globally. As a leader in Solutions Marketing, we inspire all of our people to boldly innovate, collaborate, and deliver answers to patients. We lead collectively, demonstrating an enterprise mindset and consistently demonstrating our values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion while taking accountability for the whole beyond our own area of responsibility.

As the Subchapter Lead, Brand & Creative Management, you will step into a globally focused leadership role responsible for directing the structural integrity of the Roche Diagnostics product brand portfolio and guiding high-impact creative strategy. Balancing a heavy strategic focus with operational oversight, you will plan long-term brand foundations—including defining brand vision, values, and personas—while managing ongoing tactical initiatives like packaging implementation and trademarking resolutions. You will actively partner with Customer Areas, cross-functional teams, Group Communications, and external stakeholders to drive operational efficiencies across the creative ecosystem, establish robust brand governance, and ensure that compelling narratives are seamlessly translated into impactful creative visions.


The Opportunity

Define and drive the long-term overarching global Brand and Creative strategy, leading the team in defining overarching brand architecture, governance, naming conventions, and trademarking strategies to ensure long-term structural integrity and a cohesive global customer experience.Serve as an active member of the Solutions Marketing Leadership Team to co-create overarching marketing strategy, partnering extensively with peer Subchapter Leads, Network Leads, Customer Area IBLs, and Dia Global Marketing to ensure cross-functional alignment and unified brand narratives.Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global team of comprising Product Brand Managers and Creative Managers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and independent innovation to unlock team potential and build specialized capabilities.Direct the overarching global creative strategy and champion high-impact execution, serving as the strategic checkpoint to ensure all deliverables reflect Roche’s quality standards, while acting as the global steward and advocate for Dia product brands to champion brand education and reputational trust across the enterprise.Drive the strategic optimization and operational excellence of the future-ready creative ecosystem by introducing structured processes, integrating optimization tools, standardizing asset management, and developing rigorous quality control processes.Guide the strategic management of Content Lab Creative Services and manage relationships, strategic negotiations, and robust external talent pools with global external creative agencies, vendors, and procurement partners to ensure maximum return on investment for creative budgets.Act as a Systems Thinker to analyze complex challenges, frequently consulting, negotiating, and aligning with expansive stakeholder groups at peer and senior leadership levels to navigate complex brand hierarchies, resolve overarching governance issues, and manage competing interests.
Who You Are

You hold a University degree in Branding, Marketing, Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or Communications (MBA or Master’s Degree strongly preferred) and possess fluency in written and spoken English.You bring 8+ years of relevant senior work experience in brand and creative management roles, along with 5+ years of experience leading, managing, coaching, and developing high-performing teams (experience managing brands in the medical device or diagnostics industry is strongly preferred).You possess proven Brand & Creative expertise to apply sophisticated brand principles within a complex, evolving global ecosystem, translating marketing data and overarching business objectives into compelling creative visions, cohesive long-term brand architectures, and customer journey mapping.You demonstrate Authentic, Courageous, and Transformational Leadership to navigate complexity with resilience, empower your teams to achieve ambitious divisional goals, and constructively challenge the status quo to transform challenges into opportunities.You have exceptional project, conflict, and stakeholder management skills to expertly resolve competing interests, oversee simultaneous portfolios across a highly matrixed organization, break down silos to standardize processes, and build enterprise-wide consensus.
 

 

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Rotkreuz. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

Who we areA healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.
